[];\n\n  const filteredCampaigns = dateRange\n    ? campaigns.filter((c) => {\n        if (!c.scheduledAt) return false;\n        const d = dayjs(c.scheduledAt);\n        const [start, end] = dateRange;\n        if (start && d.isBefore(start, 'day')) return false;\n        if (end && d.isAfter(end, 'day')) return false;\n        return true;\n      })\n    : campaigns;\n\n  function handleCopy(campaign: Campaign) {\n    message.success(`已复制活动「${campaign.name}」，请在创建页编辑`);\n    navigate('/campaigns/create');\n  }\n\n  const columns: ColumnsType<Campaign> = [\n    {\n      title: '活动名称',\n      dataIndex: 'name',\n      key: 'name',\n      width: 220,\n      ellipsis: true,\n      render: (text: string) => <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{text}</span>,\n    },\n    {\n      title: '模板',\n      dataIndex: 'templateName',\n      key: 'templateName',\n      width: 150,\n      ellipsis: true,\n    },\n    {\n      title: '发送量',\n      dataIndex: 'totalRecipients',\n      key: 'totalRecipients',\n      width: 100,\n      align: 'right',\n      render: (val: number) => val.toLocaleString(),\n    },\n    {\n      title: '打开率',\n      dataIndex: 'openRate',\n      key: 'openRate',\n      width: 90,\n      align: 'right',\n      render: (val: number) => (val > 0 ? `${val}%` : '-'),\n    },\n    {\n      title: '点击率',\n      dataIndex: 'clickRate',\n      key: 'clickRate',\n      width: 90,\n      align: 'right',\n      render: (val: number) => (val > 0 ? `${val}%` : '-'),\n    },\n    {\n      title: '状态',\n      dataIndex: 'status',\n      key: 'status',\n      width: 100,\n      render: (status: CampaignStatus) => <StatusTag status={status} />,\n    },\n    {\n      title: '计划发送时间',\n      dataIndex: 'scheduledAt',\n      key: 'scheduledAt',\n      width: 160,\n      render: (val: string | null) =>\n        val ? dayjs(val).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm') : '-',\n      sorter: (a, b) => {\n        if (!a.scheduledAt) return 1;\n        if (!b.scheduledAt) return -1;\n        return dayjs(a.scheduledAt).valueOf() - dayjs(b.scheduledAt).valueOf();\n      },\n    },\n    {\n      title: '创建者',\n      dataIndex: 'createdBy',\n      key: 'createdBy',\n      width: 100,\n    },\n    {\n      title: '操作',\n      key: 'actions',\n      width: 120,\n      fixed: 'right',\n      render: (_: unknown, record: Campaign) => (\n        <Space size=\"small\">\n          <Tooltip title=\"查看详情\">\n            <Button\n              type=\"link\"\n              size=\"small\"\n              icon={<EyeOutlined />}\n              onClick={() => navigate(`/campaigns/${record.id}`)}\n            />\n          </Tooltip>\n          <Tooltip title=\"复制活动\">\n            <Button\n              type=\"link\"\n              size=\"small\"\n              icon={<CopyOutlined />}\n              onClick={() => handleCopy(record)}\n            />\n          </Tooltip>\n        </Space>\n      ),\n    },\n  ];\n\n  const statusOptions = [\n    { value: 'all', label: '全部状态' },\n    ...Object.entries(CAMPAIGN_STATUS_CONFIG).map(([value, { label }]) => ({\n      value,\n      label,\n    })),\n  ];\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <div\n        style={{\n          display: 'flex',\n          justifyContent: 'space-between',\n          alignItems: 'center',\n          marginBottom: 24,\n        }}\n      >\n        <Title level={4} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n          活动管理\n        </Title>\n        <Button\n          type=\"primary\"\n          icon={<PlusOutlined />}\n          onClick={() => navigate('/campaigns/create')}\n        >\n          创建新活动\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n\n      <Space wrap style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Select\n          value={statusFilter}\n          onChange={setStatusFilter}\n          options={statusOptions}\n          style={{ width: 140 }}\n        />\n        <RangePicker\n          onChange={(dates) =>\n            setDateRange(dates as [dayjs.Dayjs | null, dayjs.Dayjs | null] | null)\n          }\n          placeholder={['开始日期', '结束日期']}\n        />\n        <Input\n          placeholder=\"搜索活动名称、模板、创建者...\"\n          prefix={<SearchOutlined />}\n          value={searchText}\n          onChange={(e) => setSearchText(e.target.value)}\n          allowClear\n          style={{ width: 280 }}\n        />\n      </Space>\n\n      <Table\n        columns={columns}\n        dataSource={filteredCampaigns}\n        rowKey=\"id\"\n        loading={isLoading}\n        pagination={{\n          pageSize: 10,\n          showSizeChanger: true,\n          showTotal: (total) => `共 ${total} 条`,\n        }}\n        scroll={{ x: 1200 }}\n        size=\"middle\"\n      />\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { Steps, Button, Space, Card, Typography } from 'antd';\nimport { useAppSelector, useAppDispatch } from '../../../app/store';\nimport { setStep, resetCampaignCreate } from '../campaignSlice';\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport Step1Audience from './steps/Step1Audience';\n\nconst { Title } = Typography;\n\nconst stepItems = [\n  { title: '选择受众' },\n  { title: '选择模板' },\n  { title: '编辑内容' },\n  { title: '预览确认' },\n  { title: '发送设置' },\n];\n\nexport default function CampaignCreatePage() {\n  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const currentStep = useAppSelector((s) => s.campaignCreate.currentStep);\n  const audienceProfile = useAppSelector((s) => s.campaignCreate.audienceProfile);\n\n  function handleBack() {\n    if (currentStep === 0) {\n      navigate('/campaigns');\n    } else {\n      dispatch(setStep(currentStep - 1));\n    }\n  }\n\n  function handleNext() {\n    dispatch(setStep(currentStep + 1));\n  }\n\n  function handleCancel() {\n    dispatch(resetCampaignCreate());\n    navigate('/campaigns');\n  }\n\n  const canGoNext = currentStep === 0 ? !!audienceProfile : true;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ maxWidth: 1200, margin: '0 auto' }}>\n      <div\n        style={{\n          display: 'flex',\n          justifyContent: 'space-between',\n          alignItems: 'center',\n          marginBottom: 24,\n        }}\n      >\n        <Title level={4} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n          创建新活动\n        </Title>\n        <Button onClick={handleCancel}>取消</Button>\n      </div>\n\n      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>\n        <Steps current={currentStep} items={stepItems} />\n      </Card>\n\n      <div style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>\n        {currentStep === 0 && <Step1Audience />}\n        {currentStep === 1 && <PlaceholderStep title=\"选择模板\" />}\n        {currentStep === 2 && <PlaceholderStep title=\"编辑内容\" />}\n        {currentStep === 3 && <PlaceholderStep title=\"预览确认\" />}\n        {currentStep === 4 && <PlaceholderStep title=\"发送设置\" />}\n      </div>\n\n      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>\n        <Space>\n          <Button onClick={handleBack}>\n            {currentStep === 0 ? '返回列表' : '上一步'}\n          </Button>\n          {currentStep < 4 && (\n            <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleNext} disabled={!canGoNext}>\n              下一步\n            </Button>\n          )}\n        </Space>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction PlaceholderStep({ title }: { title: string }) {\n  return (\n    <Card>\n      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 60, color: '#8c8c8c' }}>\n        <h3>{title}</h3>\n        <p>此步骤正在开发中...</p>\n      </div>\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-frontend\\src\\features\\campaigns\\pages\\steps\\CsvUploadPanel.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useState } from 'react';\nimport { Upload, Typography, Alert, Spin } from 'antd';\nimport { InboxOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';\nimport { useAppDispatch } from '../../../../app/store';\nimport {\n  setRecipientStats,\n  setAudienceProfile,\n  setRecipientListId,\n} from '../../campaignSlice';\nimport { useUploadCsvRecipientsMutation } from '../../../recipients/recipientApi';\nimport type { UploadFile } from 'antd/es/upload';\n\nconst { Dragger } = Upload;\nconst { Text } = Typography;\n\nexport default function CsvUploadPanel() {\n  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();\n  const [uploadCsv, { isLoading }] = useUploadCsvRecipientsMutation();\n  const [fileList, setFileList] = useState<UploadFile[]>([]);\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);\n\n  async function handleUpload(file: File) {\n    setError(null);\n\n    if (!file.name.endsWith('.csv')) {\n      setError('仅支持 .csv 格式文件');\n      return false;\n    }\n\n    const text = await file.text();\n    const lines = text.trim().split('\\n');\n    if (lines.length < 2) {\n      setError('CSV 文件至少需要包含表头和一行数据');\n      return false;\n    }\n\n    const header = lines[0].toLowerCase();\n    if (!header.includes('email') || !header.includes('segment') || !header.includes('lang')) {\n      setError('CSV 必须包含 email, segment, lang 三列');\n      return false;\n    }\n\n    const rowCount = lines.length - 1;\n\n    try {\n      const result = await uploadCsv({ rowCount }).unwrap();\n      dispatch(setRecipientStats(result.stats));\n      dispatch(setAudienceProfile(result.audienceProfile));\n      dispatch(setRecipientListId('csv-list-' + Date.now()));\n      setFileList([\n        {\n          uid: '-1',\n          name: file.name,\n          status: 'done',\n          size: file.size,\n        },\n      ]);\n    } catch {\n      setError('上传处理失败，请重试');\n    }\n\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <Spin spinning={isLoading}>\n      {error && (\n        <Alert\n          type=\"error\"\n          message={error}\n          showIcon\n          closable\n          onClose={() => setError(null)}\n          style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      <Dragger\n        accept=\".csv\"\n        maxCount={1}\n        fileList={fileList}\n        beforeUpload={handleUpload}\n        onRemove={() => {\n          setFileList([]);\n          dispatch(setRecipientStats(null as never));\n          dispatch(setAudienceProfile(null as never));\n        }}\n        style={{ padding: '20px 0' }}\n      >\n        <p className=\"ant-upload-drag-icon\">\n          <InboxOutlined />\n        </p>\n        <p className=\"ant-upload-text\">将 CSV 文件拖到此处，或点击上传</p>\n        <p className=\"ant-upload-hint\">\n          <Text type=\"secondary\">\n            支持格式: .csv | 必须包含 email, segment, lang 三列 | 可选列: subscription_plan\n          </Text>\n        </p>\n      </Dragger>\n    </Spin>\n  );\n}\n"
}

}

 "contents": "import { createBrowserRouter, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport AppLayout from '../components/AppLayout';\nimport PrivateRoute from '../components/PrivateRoute';\nimport LoginPage from '../features/auth/pages/LoginPage';\nimport CampaignListPage from '../features/campaigns/pages/CampaignListPage';\nimport CampaignCreatePage from '../features/campaigns/pages/CampaignCreatePage';\nimport CampaignDetailPage from '../features/campaigns/pages/CampaignDetailPage';\nimport UnsubscribeListPage from '../features/unsubscribe/pages/UnsubscribeListPage';\nimport UserManagePage from '../features/settings/pages/UserManagePage';\n\nfunction PlaceholderPage({ title }: { title: string }) {\n  return (\n    <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 80, color: '#8c8c8c' }}>\n      <h2>{title}</h2>\n      <p>此页面正在开发中...</p>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n\nconst router = createBrowserRouter([\n  {\n    path: '/login',\n    element: <LoginPage />,\n  },\n  {\n    path: '/',\n    element: (\n      <PrivateRoute>\n        <AppLayout />\n      </PrivateRoute>\n    ),\n    children: [\n      { index: true, element: <Navigate to=\"/campaigns\" replace /> },\n      { path: 'campaigns', element: <CampaignListPage /> },\n      { path: 'campaigns/create', element: <CampaignCreatePage /> },\n      { path: 'campaigns/:id', element: <CampaignDetailPage /> },\n      { path: 'templates', element: <PlaceholderPage title=\"模板管理\" /> },\n      { path: 'unsubscribes', element: <UnsubscribeListPage /> },\n      { path: 'reports/trends', element: <PlaceholderPage title=\"历史趋势\" /> },\n      {\n        path: 'settings/users',\n        element: (\n          <PrivateRoute requiredRole=\"admin\">\n            <UserManagePage />\n          </PrivateRoute>\n        ),\n      },\n    ],\n  },\n]);\n\nexport default router;\n"
}

 "contents": "import { createSlice, PayloadAction } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\nimport type { AuthUser } from '../../types';\n\ninterface AuthState {\n  token: string | null;\n  user: AuthUser | null;\n}\n\nfunction loadAuthFromStorage(): AuthState {\n  try {\n    const token = localStorage.getItem('edm_token');\n    const userStr = localStorage.getItem('edm_user');\n    if (token && userStr) {\n      return { token, user: JSON.parse(userStr) as AuthUser };\n    }\n  } catch {\n    // ignore corrupted data\n  }\n  return { token: null, user: null };\n}\n\nconst initialState: AuthState = loadAuthFromStorage();\n\nconst authSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'auth',\n  initialState,\n  reducers: {\n    setCredentials(state, action: PayloadAction<{ token: string; user: AuthUser }>) {\n      state.token = action.payload.token;\n      state.user = action.payload.user;\n      localStorage.setItem('edm_token', action.payload.token);\n      localStorage.setItem('edm_user', JSON.stringify(action.payload.user));\n    },\n    logout(state) {\n      state.token = null;\n      state.user = null;\n      localStorage.removeItem('edm_token');\n      localStorage.removeItem('edm_user');\n    },\n  },\n});\n\nexport const { setCredentials, logout } = authSlice.actions;\nexport default authSlice.reducer;\n"
}

 "contents": "import { createSlice, type PayloadAction } from '@reduxjs/toolkit';\nimport type { AuthUser } from '../../types';\n\ninterface AuthState {\n  token: string | null;\n  user: AuthUser | null;\n}\n\nfunction loadAuthFromStorage(): AuthState {\n  try {\n    const token = localStorage.getItem('edm_token');\n    const userStr = localStorage.getItem('edm_user');\n    if (token && userStr) {\n      return { token, user: JSON.parse(userStr) as AuthUser };\n    }\n  } catch {\n    // ignore corrupted storage\n  }\n  return { token: null, user: null };\n}\n\nconst initialState: AuthState = loadAuthFromStorage();\n\nconst authSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'auth',\n  initialState,\n  reducers: {\n    setCredentials(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<{ token: string; user: AuthUser }>,\n    ) {\n      state.token = action.payload.token;\n      state.user = action.payload.user;\n      localStorage.setItem('edm_token', action.payload.token);\n      localStorage.setItem('edm_user', JSON.stringify(action.payload.user));\n    },\n    logout(state) {\n      state.token = null;\n      state.user = null;\n      localStorage.removeItem('edm_token');\n      localStorage.removeItem('edm_user');\n    },\n  },\n});\n\nexport const { setCredentials, logout } = authSlice.actions;\nexport default authSlice.reducer;\n"
}

## 完成情况

### Phase 1.2: 登录模块 ✅

- **`authSlice.ts`** — 包含 `setCredentials` / `logout` actions，JWT token 和 user 数据持久化到 `localStorage`，页面刷新后自动恢复登录态
- **`authApi.ts`** — RTK Query API，Mock 模式下支持两个 Demo 账号（admin/operator），返回包含 `AuthUser` 类型的用户信息
- **`LoginPage.tsx`** — 渐变背景登录页，邮箱/密码表单，登录错误提示，Demo 账号提示区域，支持登录后跳转回原页面
- **`PrivateRoute.tsx`** — 路由守卫组件，未登录重定向到 `/login`（携带 `from` state），支持 `requiredRole` 权限检查，无权限显示 403 页面
- **`useAuth.ts`** — 提供 `isAuthenticated` / `user` / `token` / `logout`
- **`usePermission.ts`** — 提供 `isAdmin` / `isOperator` / `hasPermission(role)`
- **路由** — `/login` 公开页面，`/` 下所有路由被 `PrivateRoute` 包裹，`/settings/users` 额外要求 `admin` 角色

### Phase 1.3: 活动列表页 ✅

  - RTK Query `useListCampaignsQuery` 获取数据（Mock 延迟 500ms）
  - **状态筛选** — Select 组件，支持按 draft/ready/scheduled/sending/completed/failed 过滤
  - **时间范围** — DatePicker.RangePicker 按计划发送时间过滤
  - **关键词搜索** — 搜索活动名称、模板、创建者
  - **StatusTag 组件** — 根据状态显示不同颜色标签
  - **复制操作** — 点击复制按钮 → 提示成功 → 跳转创建页
  - **详情跳转** — 点击详情 → `/campaigns/:id`

### Phase 1.4: Step 1 选择受众 ✅

- **`StepAudience.tsx`** — 完整的双数据源受众选择组件：

 "contents": "import type { ContentFields } from '../types';\n\nexport function emptyContentFields(): ContentFields {\n  return {\n    email_title: '',\n    greeting: '',\n    intro_line: '',\n    body_paragraphs: [''],\n    highlight_title: '',\n    highlight_desc: '',\n    highlight_items: [''],\n    highlight_note: '',\n    cta_text: '',\n    cta_url: '',\n    closing_text: '',\n    team_name: '',\n    send_date: '',\n  };\n}\n\nexport function isContentComplete(c: ContentFields | undefined): boolean {\n  if (!c) return false;\n  return !!(c.email_title && c.intro_line && c.cta_text);\n}\n\nexport function renderEmailHtml(\n  templateHtml: string,\n  content: ContentFields,\n): string {\n  let html = templateHtml;\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{email_title\\}\\}/g, content.email_title);\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{greeting\\}\\}/g, content.greeting);\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{intro_line\\}\\}/g, content.intro_line);\n  html = html.replace(\n    /\\{\\{body_paragraphs\\}\\}/g,\n    content.body_paragraphs.map((p) => `<p>${p}</p>`).join(''),\n  );\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{highlight_title\\}\\}/g, content.highlight_title);\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{highlight_desc\\}\\}/g, content.highlight_desc);\n  html = html.replace(\n    /\\{\\{highlight_items\\}\\}/g,\n    content.highlight_items.map((i) => `<li>${i}</li>`).join(''),\n  );\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{highlight_note\\}\\}/g, content.highlight_note);\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{cta_text\\}\\}/g, content.cta_text);\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{cta_url\\}\\}/g, content.cta_url);\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{closing_text\\}\\}/g, content.closing_text);\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{team_name\\}\\}/g, content.team_name);\n  html = html.replace(/\\{\\{send_date\\}\\}/g, content.send_date);\n  return html;\n}\n\nexport function formatNumber(n: number): string {\n  return n.toLocaleString('zh-CN');\n}\n\nexport function formatPercent(n: number): string {\n  return `${(n * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;\n}\n"
}

'../../types';\nimport { emptyContentFields } from '../../utils/helpers';\n\nconst initialState: CampaignCreateState = {\n  currentStep: 0,\n\n  recipientSource: 'database',\n  recipientListId: null,\n  recipientStats: null,\n  audienceProfile: null,\n\n  templateId: null,\n\n  editMode: 'manual',\n  activeSegment: 'S',\n  activeLang: 'zh-CN',\n  autoInput: {\n    materialText: '',\n    materialFileUrl: null,\n    tone: 'professional',\n    ctaUrl: '',\n    segmentStrategies: {},\n  },\n  contents: {},\n  segments: [\n    { code: 'S', tracking_params: { utm_segment: 'S' } },\n    { code: 'A', tracking_params: { utm_segment: 'A' } },\n    { code: 'B', tracking_params: { utm_segment: 'B' } },\n    { code: 'C', tracking_params: { utm_segment: 'C' } },\n  ],\n  aiStatus: {\n    generating: false,\n    autoGenerating: false,\n    autoProgress: {},\n    translating: {},\n  },\n\n  sendConfig: {\n    type: 'immediate',\n    scheduledAt: null,\n  },\n};\n\nconst campaignCreateSlice = createSlice({\n  name: 'campaignCreate',\n  initialState,\n  reducers: {\n    setStep(state, action: PayloadAction<number>) {\n      state.currentStep = action.payload;\n    },\n    nextStep(state) {\n      if (state.currentStep < 4) state.currentStep += 1;\n    },\n    prevStep(state) {\n      if (state.currentStep > 0) state.currentStep -= 1;\n    },\n\n    // Step 1\n    setRecipientSource(state, action: PayloadAction<'database' | 'csv'>) {\n      state.recipientSource = action.payload;\n    },\n    setRecipientStats(state, action: PayloadAction<RecipientStats>) {\n      state.recipientStats = action.payload;\n    },\n    setAudienceProfile(state, action: PayloadAction<AudienceProfile>) {\n      state.audienceProfile = action.payload;\n    },\n    setRecipientListId(state, action: PayloadAction<string>) {\n      state.recipientListId = action.payload;\n    },\n\n    // Step 2\n    setTemplateId(state, action: PayloadAction<string | null>) {\n      state.templateId = action.payload;\n    },\n\n    // Step 3\n    setEditMode(state, action: PayloadAction<'manual' | 'auto'>) {\n      state.editMode = action.payload;\n    },\n    setActiveSegment(state, action: PayloadAction<string>) {\n      state.activeSegment = action.payload;\n    },\n    setActiveLang(state, action: PayloadAction<string>) {\n      state.activeLang = action.payload;\n    },\n    setAutoInput(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<Partial<CampaignCreateState['autoInput']>>,\n    ) {\n      Object.assign(state.autoInput, action.payload);\n    },\n    setSegmentStrategy(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<{ segment: string; strategy: string }>,\n    ) {\n      state.autoInput.segmentStrategies[action.payload.segment] =\n        action.payload.strategy;\n    },\n    setContentField(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<{\n        segment: string;\n        lang: string;\n        field: keyof ContentFields;\n        value: string | string[];\n      }>,\n    ) {\n      const { segment, lang, field, value } = action.payload;\n      if (!state.contents[segment]) state.contents[segment] = {};\n      if (!state.contents[segment][lang])\n        state.contents[segment][lang] = emptyContentFields();\n      (state.contents[segment][lang][field] as typeof value) = value;\n    },\n    setContent(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<{\n        segment: string;\n        lang: string;\n        content: ContentFields;\n      }>,\n    ) {\n      const { segment, lang, content } = action.payload;\n      if (!state.contents[segment]) state.contents[segment] = {};\n      state.contents[segment][lang] = content;\n    },\n    copyContentToSegment(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<{ from: string; to: string }>,\n    ) {\n      const { from, to } = action.payload;\n      if (state.contents[from]) {\n        state.contents[to] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.contents[from]));\n      }\n    },\n    setSegmentTrackingParams(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<{\n        code: string;\n        params: Record<string, string>;\n      }>,\n    ) {\n      const seg = state.segments.find((s) => s.code === action.payload.code);\n      if (seg) seg.tracking_params = action.payload.params;\n    },\n\n    // AI status\n    setGenerating(state, action: PayloadAction<boolean>) {\n      state.aiStatus.generating = action.payload;\n    },\n    setAutoGenerating(state, action: PayloadAction<boolean>) {\n      state.aiStatus.autoGenerating = action.payload;\n    },\n    setAutoProgress(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<{\n        segment: string;\n        lang: string;\n        status: 'pending' | 'loading' | 'done' | 'error';\n      }>,\n    ) {\n      const { segment, lang, status } = action.payload;\n      if (!state.aiStatus.autoProgress[segment])\n        state.aiStatus.autoProgress[segment] = {};\n      state.aiStatus.autoProgress[segment][lang] = status;\n    },\n\n    // Step 5\n    setSendConfig(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<Partial<CampaignCreateState['sendConfig']>>,\n    ) {\n      Object.assign(state.sendConfig, action.payload);\n    },\n\n    resetCampaignCreate() {\n      return initialState;\n    },\n  },\n});\n\nexport const campaignCreateActions = campaignCreateSlice.actions;\nexport default campaignCreateSlice.reducer;\n"
}

 "contents": "import { createApi, fetchBaseQuery } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';\nimport { mockTemplates } from '../../mocks/templates';\nimport { mockCampaigns } from '../../mocks/campaigns';\n\nexport const campaignApi = createApi({\n  reducerPath: 'campaignApi',\n  baseQuery: fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: '/api' }),\n  tagTypes: ['Campaign', 'Template', 'Report'],\n  endpoints: (builder) => ({\n    listCampaigns: builder.query({\n      queryFn: async () => {\n        await delay(300);\n        return { data: mockCampaigns };\n      },\n      providesTags: ['Campaign'],\n    }),\n\n    listTemplates: builder.query({\n      queryFn: async () => {\n        await delay(200);\n        return { data: mockTemplates };\n      },\n      providesTags: ['Template'],\n    }),\n\n    getTemplate: builder.query<(typeof mockTemplates)[0] | undefined, string>({\n      queryFn: async (id) => {\n        await delay(100);\n        return { data: mockTemplates.find((t) => t.id === id) };\n      },\n    }),\n\n    sendTestEmail: builder.mutation<\n      { success: boolean },\n      { campaignId: string; email: string; segment: string; lang: string }\n    >({\n      queryFn: async () => {\n        await delay(1000);\n        return { data: { success: true } };\n      },\n    }),\n\n    triggerSend: builder.mutation<\n      { taskId: string; status: string },\n      { campaignId: string; sendType: string; scheduledAt: string | null }\n    >({\n      queryFn: async () => {\n        await delay(500);\n        return {\n          data: {\n            taskId: `task-${Date.now()}`,\n            status: 'queued',\n          },\n        };\n      },\n    }),\n\n    getSendProgress: builder.query<\n      { total: number; sent: number; failed: number; status: string },\n      string\n    >({\n      queryFn: async () => {\n        await delay(300);\n        const total = 11500;\n        const sent = Math.min(total, Math.floor(Math.random() * total));\n        return {\n          data: {\n            total,\n            sent,\n            failed: Math.floor(sent * 0.003),\n            status: sent >= total ? 'completed' : 'sending',\n          },\n        };\n      },\n    }),\n  }),\n});\n\nfunction delay(ms: number) {\n  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));\n}\n\nexport const {\n  useListCampaignsQuery,\n  useListTemplatesQuery,\n  useGetTemplateQuery,\n  useSendTestEmailMutation,\n  useTriggerSendMutation,\n  useGetSendProgressQuery,\n} = campaignApi;\n"
}

}

 "contents": "import { Tabs, Badge } from 'antd';\nimport { CheckCircleFilled, ClockCircleOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';\nimport { LANG_MAP } from '../utils/constants';\n\ntype LangStatus = 'done' | 'pending' | 'loading' | 'error';\n\ninterface LangTabsProps {\n  langs: string[];\n  activeLang: string;\n  status?: Record<string, LangStatus>;\n  onChange: (lang: string) => void;\n}\n\nfunction statusIcon(s?: LangStatus) {\n  if (s === 'done')\n    return <CheckCircleFilled style={{ color: '#52c41a', marginLeft: 4 }} />;\n  if (s === 'loading')\n    return <Badge status=\"processing\" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }} />;\n  if (s === 'error')\n    return <Badge status=\"error\" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }} />;\n  return <ClockCircleOutlined style={{ color: '#bfbfbf', marginLeft: 4 }} />;\n}\n\nexport default function LangTabs({\n  langs,\n  activeLang,\n  status,\n  onChange,\n}: LangTabsProps) {\n  return (\n    <Tabs\n      activeKey={activeLang}\n      onChange={onChange}\n      size=\"small\"\n      items={langs.map((code) => ({\n        key: code,\n        label: (\n          <span>\n            {LANG_MAP[code] ?? code}\n            {statusIcon(status?.[code])}\n          </span>\n        ),\n      }))}\n    />\n  );\n}\n"
}

} from '../../../utils/constants';\nimport SegmentBadge from '../../../components/SegmentBadge';\n\nconst { Text } = Typography;\n\nexport default function StepSelectAudience() {\n  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();\n  const { recipientStats, audienceProfile } = useAppSelector(\n    (s) => s.campaignCreate,\n  );\n\n  const handleLoadMock = () => {\n    dispatch(campaignCreateActions.setRecipientStats(mockRecipientStats));\n    dispatch(campaignCreateActions.setAudienceProfile(mockAudienceProfile));\n    dispatch(campaignCreateActions.setRecipientListId('mock-list-001'));\n    message.success('已加载 Demo 受众数据');\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ maxWidth: 900, margin: '0 auto' }}>\n      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Typography.Title level={5}>选择目标受众</Typography.Title>\n        <Text type=\"secondary\">\n          Demo 模式：点击下方按钮加载模拟受众数据，正式版将支持数据库查询和 CSV 上传。\n        </Text>\n        <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>\n          <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleLoadMock}>\n            加载 Demo 受众数据\n          </Button>\n          {recipientStats && (\n            <Text style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>\n              <CheckCircleFilled style={{ color: '#52c41a', marginRight: 4 }} />\n              已加载 {recipientStats.total.toLocaleString()} 人\n            </Text>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      </Card>\n\n      {audienceProfile && (\n        <>\n          <Card title=\"受众画像摘要\" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n            <Descriptions column={2} size=\"small\">\n              <Descriptions.Item label=\"总人数\">\n                {audienceProfile.total.toLocaleString()}\n              </Descriptions.Item>\n              <Descriptions.Item label=\"付费占比\">\n                {(audienceProfile.paidRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}%\n              </Descriptions.Item>\n              <Descriptions.Item label=\"7日活跃率\">\n                {(audienceProfile.activeRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}%\n              </Descriptions.Item>\n              <Descriptions.Item label=\"主要语言\">\n                {audienceProfile.topLanguages.join(', ')}\n              </Descriptions.Item>\n            </Descriptions>\n            <Card\n              size=\"small\"\n              style={{ marginTop: 12, background: '#f6ffed', borderColor: '#b7eb8f' }}\n            >\n              <Text>{audienceProfile.audienceSummary}</Text>\n            </Card>\n          </Card>\n\n          <Card title=\"分层分布\" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n            {Object.entries(audienceProfile.segmentProfiles).map(\n              ([seg, profile]) => (\n                <div key={seg} style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>\n                  <SegmentBadge segment={seg} count={profile.count} />\n                  <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>\n                    {profile.characterSummary}\n                  </Text>\n                </div>\n              ),\n            )}\n          </Card>\n\n          {recipientStats && (\n            <Card title=\"抽样预览\">\n              <Table\n                size=\"small\"\n                dataSource={recipientStats.sample}\n                rowKey=\"email\"\n                pagination={false}\n                columns={[\n                  { title: '邮箱', dataIndex: 'email' },\n                  {\n                    title: '分层',\n                    dataIndex: 'segment',\n                    render: (s: string) => (\n                      <SegmentBadge segment={s} />\n                    ),\n                  },\n                  { title: '语言', dataIndex: 'lang' },\n                  { title: '订阅计划', dataIndex: 'plan' },\n                ]}\n              />\n            </Card>\n          )}\n        </>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-frontend\\src\\features\\campaigns\\components\\StepSelectTemplate.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useMemo } from 'react';\nimport {\n  Card,\n  Row,\n  Col,\n  Tag,\n  Typography,\n  Empty,\n  Spin,\n  Input,\n  Select,\n  Badge,\n} from 'antd';\nimport {\n  CheckCircleFilled,\n  FileTextOutlined,\n  StarFilled,\n} from '@ant-design/icons';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from '../../../app/store';\nimport { campaignCreateActions } from '../campaignSlice';\nimport { useListTemplatesQuery } from '../campaignApi';\nimport type { AudienceProfile, TemplateItem } from '../../../types';\nimport { TEMPLATE_CATEGORIES } from '../../../utils/constants';\n\nconst { Text, Title } = Typography;\n\nfunction getRecommendedTemplateIds(profile: AudienceProfile | null): Set<string> {\n  if (!profile) return new Set();\n  const ids = new Set<string>();\n  if (profile.paidRatio > 0.4) {\n    ids.add('tpl-product-launch');\n  }\n  if (profile.paidRatio <= 0.4) {\n    ids.add('tpl-promo-general');\n  }\n  const hasLowActive = Object.values(profile.segmentProfiles).some(\n    (p) => p.avgActiveDay > 30,\n  );\n  if (hasLowActive) {\n    ids.add('tpl-retention');\n  }\n  return ids;\n}\n\nfunction TemplateCard({\n  template,\n  selected,\n  recommended,\n  onClick,\n}: {\n  template: TemplateItem;\n  selected: boolean;\n  recommended: boolean;\n  onClick: () => void;\n}) {\n  const categoryLabel =\n    TEMPLATE_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.value === template.category)?.label ??\n    template.category;\n\n  return (\n    <Badge.Ribbon\n      text=\"推荐\"\n      color=\"red\"\n      style={{ display: recommended ? undefined : 'none' }}\n    >\n      <Card\n        hoverable\n        onClick={onClick}\n        style={{\n          borderColor: selected ? '#1677ff' : undefined,\n          borderWidth: selected ? 2 : 1,\n          position: 'relative',\n          height: '100%',\n        }}\n        styles={{\n          body: { padding: 16, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' },\n        }}\n      >\n        {selected && (\n          <CheckCircleFilled\n            style={{\n              position: 'absolute',\n              top: 8,\n              left: 8,\n              fontSize: 20,\n              color: '#1677ff',\n              zIndex: 1,\n            }}\n          />\n        )}\n\n        <div\n          style={{\n            height: 120,\n            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #f0f2f5, #e6f4ff)',\n            borderRadius: 6,\n            display: 'flex',\n            alignItems: 'center',\n            justifyContent: 'center',\n            marginBottom: 12,\n          }}\n        >\n          <FileTextOutlined style={{ fontSize: 36, color: '#1677ff' }} />\n        </div>\n\n        <Title level={5} style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 14 }}>\n          {template.name}\n          {recommended && (\n            <StarFilled style={{ color: '#faad14', marginLeft: 6, fontSize: 12 }} />\n          )}\n        </Title>\n\n        <Text\n          type=\"secondary\"\n          style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4, flex: 1 }}\n        >\n          {template.description}\n        </Text>\n\n        <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>\n          <Tag color=\"blue\" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>\n            {categoryLabel}\n          </Tag>\n          {template.tags.slice(0, 2).map((t) => (\n            <Tag key={t} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>\n              {t}\n            </Tag>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </Card>\n    </Badge.Ribbon>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function StepSelectTemplate() {\n  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();\n  const { templateId, audienceProfile } = useAppSelector(\n    (s) => s.campaignCreate,\n  );\n  const { data: templates, isLoading } = useListTemplatesQuery(undefined);\n\n  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');\n  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string>('all');\n\n  const recommendedIds = useMemo(\n    () => getRecommendedTemplateIds(audienceProfile),\n    [audienceProfile],\n  );\n\n  const filtered = useMemo(() => {\n    if (!templates) return [];\n    return (templates as TemplateItem[]).filter((t) => {\n      if (category !== 'all' && t.category !== category) return false;\n      if (search && !t.name.includes(search) && !t.description.includes(search))\n        return false;\n      return true;\n    });\n  }, [templates, search, category]);\n\n  const sorted = useMemo(() => {\n    return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {\n      const aRec = recommendedIds.has(a.id) ? 0 : 1;\n      const bRec = recommendedIds.has(b.id) ? 0 : 1;\n      return aRec - bRec;\n    });\n  }, [filtered, recommendedIds]);\n\n  if (isLoading) return <Spin style={{ display: 'block', margin: '80px auto' }} />;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ maxWidth: 960, margin: '0 auto' }}>\n      {audienceProfile && recommendedIds.size > 0 && (\n        <Card\n          size=\"small\"\n          style={{\n            marginBottom: 16,\n            background: '#fffbe6',\n            borderColor: '#ffe58f',\n          }}\n        >\n          <StarFilled style={{ color: '#faad14', marginRight: 6 }} />\n          <Text>\n            根据受众画像（付费占比{' '}\n            {(audienceProfile.paidRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}%\n            ），已为你标记推荐模板\n          </Text>\n        </Card>\n      )}\n\n      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Input.Search\n          placeholder=\"搜索模板名称...\"\n          allowClear\n          value={search}\n          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}\n          style={{ width: 260 }}\n        />\n        <Select\n          value={category}\n          onChange={setCategory}\n          style={{ width: 140 }}\n          options={[\n            { value: 'all', label: '全部分类' },\n            ...TEMPLATE_CATEGORIES,\n          ]}\n        />\n      </div>\n\n      {sorted.length === 0 ? (\n        <Empty description=\"暂无匹配模板\" />\n      ) : (\n        <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>\n          {sorted.map((tpl) => (\n            <Col key={tpl.id} xs={24} sm={12} md={8} lg={6}>\n              <TemplateCard\n                template={tpl}\n                selected={templateId === tpl.id}\n                recommended={recommendedIds.has(tpl.id)}\n                onClick={() =>\n                  dispatch(\n                    campaignCreateActions.setTemplateId(\n                      templateId === tpl.id ? null : tpl.id,\n                    ),\n                  )\n                }\n              />\n            </Col>\n          ))}\n        </Row>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

(\n                    <CheckCircleFilled\n                      style={{ color: '#52c41a', marginLeft: 2, fontSize: 10 }}\n                    />\n                  ) : (\n                    <ClockCircleOutlined\n                      style={{ color: '#bfbfbf', marginLeft: 2, fontSize: 10 }}\n                    />\n                  )}\n                </span>\n              </Tooltip>\n            );\n          })}\n        </div>\n      ))}\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n\nfunction ContentForm({ segment, lang }: { segment: string; lang: string }) {\n  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();\n  const content = useAppSelector(\n    (s) => s.campaignCreate.contents[segment]?.[lang],\n  ) ?? emptyContentFields();\n\n  const update = useCallback(\n    (field: keyof ContentFields, value: string | 0;\n    const langDist: Record<string, number> = {};\n    for (const lang of langs) {\n      const langTotal = audienceProfile.byLang[lang] ?? 0;\n      langDist[lang] = Math.round(\n        (langTotal / audienceProfile.total) * segTotal,\n      );\n    }\n    return {\n      key: seg,\n      segment: SEGMENT_LABELS[seg],\n      count: segTotal,\n      langDist,\n    };\n  });\n\n  const totalRow = {\n    key: 'total',\n    segment: '合计',\n    count: audienceProfile.total,\n    langDist: Object.fromEntries(\n      langs.map((l) => [l, audienceProfile.byLang[l] ?? 0]),\n    ),\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Table\n      size=\"small\"\n      pagination={false}\n      dataSource={[...dataSource, totalRow]}\n      columns={[\n        {\n          title: '分层',\n          dataIndex: 'segment',\n          render: (v: string, record) =>\n            record.key === 'total' ? <Text strong>{v}</Text> : v,\n        },\n        {\n          title: '人数',\n          dataIndex: 'count',\n          render: (v: number, record) =>\n            record.key === 'total' ? (\n              <Text strong>{v.toLocaleString()}</Text>\n            ) : (\n              v.toLocaleString()\n            ),\n        },\n        {\n          title: '语言分布',\n          dataIndex: 'langDist',\n          render: (dist: Record<string, number>) =>\n            Object.entries(dist)\n              .filter(([, v]) => v > 0)\n              .map(([lang, count]) => `${LANG_MAP[lang] ?? lang}:${count}`)\n              .join('  '),\n        },\n      ]}\n    />\n  );\n}\n\ntype SendPhase = 'config' | 'sending' | 'done';\n\nexport default function StepSendSettings() {\n  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();\n  const { sendConfig, audienceProfile } = useAppSelector(\n    (s) => s.campaignCreate,\n  );\n  const [triggerSend, { isLoading: triggering }] = useTriggerSendMutation();\n\n  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<SendPhase>('config');\n  const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [progress, setProgress] = useState({ sent: 0, total: 0, failed: 0 });\n  const pollingRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);\n\n  const stopPolling = useCallback(() => {\n    if (pollingRef.current) {\n      clearInterval(pollingRef.current);\n      pollingRef.current = null;\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    return stopPolling;\n  }, [stopPolling]);\n\n  const handleConfirmSend = async () => {\n    setConfirmOpen(false);\n    try {\n      await triggerSend({\n        campaignId: 'draft',\n        sendType: sendConfig.type,\n        scheduledAt: sendConfig.scheduledAt,\n      }).unwrap();\n\n      const total = audienceProfile?.total ?? 11500;\n      setProgress({ sent: 0, total, failed: 0 });\n      setPhase('sending');\n\n      // Simulate polling progress\n      let sent = 0;\n      pollingRef.current = setInterval(() => {\n        const batch = Math.floor(Math.random() * 800) + 400;\n        sent = Math.min(total, sent + batch);\n        const failed = Math.floor(sent * 0.003);\n        setProgress({ sent, total, failed });\n        if (sent >= total) {\n          stopPolling();\n          setPhase('done');\n        }\n      }, 600);\n    } catch {\n      message.error('发送请求失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (phase === 'sending') {\n    const pct = Math.round((progress.sent / progress.total) * 100);\n    return (\n      <div style={{ maxWidth: 600, margin: '60px auto', textAlign: 'center' }}>\n        <Title level={4}>发送中...</Title>\n        <Progress\n          type=\"circle\"\n          percent={pct}\n          format={() => `${progress.sent.toLocaleString()} / ${progress.total.toLocaleString()}`}\n          size={180}\n        />\n        <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>\n          <Text type=\"secondary\">\n            已发送 {progress.sent.toLocaleString()} 封 · 失败{' '}\n            {progress.failed} 封\n          </Text>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (phase === 'done') {\n    return (\n      <Result\n        status=\"success\"\n        title=\"发送完成\"\n        subTitle={`共发送 ${progress.total.toLocaleString()} 封邮件，失败 ${progress.failed} 封`}\n        extra={[\n          <Button\n            key=\"detail\"\n            type=\"primary\"\n            onClick={() => message.info('跳转到活动详情页（待实现）')}\n          >\n            查看活动报表\n          </Button>,\n          <Button\n            key=\"new\"\n            onClick={() => dispatch(campaignCreateActions.resetCampaignCreate())}\n          >\n            创建新活动\n          </Button>,\n        ]}\n      />\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ maxWidth: 700, margin: '0 auto' }}>\n      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Title level={5} style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>发送方式</Title>\n        <Radio.Group\n          value={sendConfig.type}\n          onChange={(e) =>\n            dispatch(\n              campaignCreateActions.setSendConfig({ type: e.target.value }),\n            )\n          }\n        >\n          <Space direction=\"vertical\">\n            <Radio value=\"immediate\">立即发送</Radio>\n            <Radio value=\"scheduled\">\n              定时发送\n              {sendConfig.type === 'scheduled' && (\n                <DatePicker\n                  showTime\n                  value={\n                    sendConfig.scheduledAt\n                      ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt)\n                      : null\n                  }\n                  onChange={(d) =>\n                    dispatch(\n                      campaignCreateActions.setSendConfig({\n                        scheduledAt: d?.toISOString() ?? null,\n                      }),\n                    )\n                  }\n                  style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}\n                  placeholder=\"选择发送时间\"\n                  disabledDate={(current) =>\n                    current && current < dayjs().startOf('day')\n                  }\n                />\n              )}\n            </Radio>\n          </Space>\n        </Radio.Group>\n      </Card>\n\n      <Card title=\"发送汇总\" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <SendSummaryTable />\n      </Card>\n\n      <Alert\n        type=\"warning\"\n        showIcon\n        icon={<ExclamationCircleFilled />}\n        message={\n          <Text>\n            确认后将发送{' '}\n            <Text strong>\n              {(audienceProfile?.total ?? 0).toLocaleString()}\n            </Text>{' '}\n            封邮件，此操作不可撤销\n          </Text>\n        }\n        style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}\n      />\n\n      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>\n        <Button\n          type=\"primary\"\n          size=\"large\"\n          icon={<SendOutlined />}\n          loading={triggering}\n          onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}\n          disabled={\n            sendConfig.type === 'scheduled' && !sendConfig.scheduledAt\n          }\n        >\n          确认发送\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n\n      <Modal\n        open={confirmOpen}\n        title={\n          <span>\n            <ExclamationCircleFilled\n              style={{ color: '#faad14', marginRight: 8 }}\n            />\n            二次确认\n          </span>\n        }\n        onOk={handleConfirmSend}\n {sendConfig.type === 'immediate'\n              ? '请完成当前步骤');\n      return;\n    }\n    dispatch(campaignCreateActions.nextStep());\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Steps\n          current={currentStep}\n          items={STEPS}\n          onChange={(step) => {\n            if (step < currentStep) {\n              dispatch(campaignCreateActions.setStep(step));\n            }\n          }}\n          style={{ maxWidth: 800, margin: '0 auto' }}\n        />\n      </Card>\n\n      <div style={{ minHeight: 400 }}>\n        <StepContent step={currentStep} />\n      </div>\n\n      {currentStep < 4 && (\n        <div\n          style={{\n            marginTop: 24,\n            display: 'flex',\n            justifyContent: 'center',\n          }}\n        >\n          <Space size=\"large\">\n            {currentStep > 0 && (\n              <Button onClick={() => dispatch(campaignCreateActions.prevStep())}>\n                上一步\n              </Button>\n            )}\n            <Button onClick={() => message.success('草稿已保存')}>\n              保存草稿\n            </Button>\n            <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleNext}>\n              下一步\n            </Button>\n          </Space>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';\nimport {\n  Card,\n  Row,\n  Col,\n  Tag,\n  Typography,\n  Empty,\n  Spin,\n  Input,\n  Select,\n  Badge,\n} from 'antd';\nimport {\n  CheckCircleFilled,\n  FileTextOutlined,\n  StarFilled,\n} from '@ant-design/icons';\nimport { useAppDispatch, useAppSelector } from '../../../app/store';\nimport { setTemplateId } from '../campaignSlice';\nimport { useListTemplatesQuery } from '../campaignApi';\nimport type { AudienceProfile, Template } from '../../../types';\n\nconst { Text, Title } = Typography;\n\nconst CATEGORY_OPTIONS = [\n  { value: 'all', label: '全部分类' },\n  { value: '促销', label: '促销' },\n  { value: '产品', label: '产品' },\n  { value: '会员', label: '会员' },\n  { value: '召回', label: '召回' },\n  { value: '简报', label: '简报' },\n  { value: '自定义', label: '自定义' },\n];\n\nfunction getRecommendedIds(profile: AudienceProfile | null): Set<string> {\n  if (!profile) return new Set();\n  const ids = new Set<string>();\n  if (profile.paidRatio > 0.4) ids.add('t2');\n  if (profile.paidRatio <= 0.4) ids.add('t1');\n  const hasLowActive = Object.values(profile.segmentProfiles).some(\n    (p) => p.avgActiveDay > 30,\n  );\n  if (hasLowActive) ids.add('t4');\n  return ids;\n}\n\nfunction TemplateCard({\n  template,\n  selected,\n  recommended,\n  onClick,\n}: {\n  template: Template;\n  selected: boolean;\n  recommended: boolean;\n  onClick: () => void;\n}) {\n  return (\n    <Badge.Ribbon\n      text=\"推荐\"\n      color=\"red\"\n      style={{ display: recommended ? undefined : 'none' }}\n    >\n      <Card\n        hoverable\n        onClick={onClick}\n        style={{\n          borderColor: selected ? '#1677ff' : undefined,\n          borderWidth: selected ? 2 : 1,\n          height: '100%',\n        }}\n        styles={{\n          body: { padding: 16, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' },\n        }}\n      >\n        {selected && (\n          <CheckCircleFilled\n            style={{\n              position: 'absolute',\n              top: 8,\n              left: 8,\n              fontSize: 20,\n              color: '#1677ff',\n              zIndex: 1,\n            }}\n          />\n        )}\n\n        <div\n          style={{\n            height: 120,\n            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #f0f2f5, #e6f4ff)',\n            borderRadius: 6,\n            display: 'flex',\n            alignItems: 'center',\n            justifyContent: 'center',\n            marginBottom: 12,\n          }}\n        >\n          <FileTextOutlined style={{ fontSize: 36, color: '#1677ff' }} />\n        </div>\n\n        <Title level={5} style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 14 }}>\n          {template.name}\n          {recommended && (\n            <StarFilled style={{ color: '#faad14', marginLeft: 6, fontSize: 12 }} />\n          )}\n        </Title>\n\n        <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4, flex: 1 }}>\n          {template.description || '暂无描述'}\n        </Text>\n\n        <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>\n          <Tag color=\"blue\" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>\n            {template.category}\n          </Tag>\n          {template.tags?.slice(0, 2).map((t) => (\n            <Tag key={t} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>\n              {t}\n            </Tag>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </Card>\n    </Badge.Ribbon>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function StepSelectTemplate() {\n  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();\n  const { templateId, audienceProfile } = useAppSelector(\n    (s) => s.campaignCreate,\n  );\n  const { data: templates, isLoading } = useListTemplatesQuery();\n\n  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');\n  const [category, setCategory] = useState('all');\n\n  const recommendedIds = useMemo(\n    () => getRecommendedIds(audienceProfile),\n    [audienceProfile],\n  );\n\n  const filtered = useMemo(() => {\n    if (!templates) return [];\n    return templates.filter((t) => {\n      if (category !== 'all' && t.category !== category) return false;\n      if (\n        search &&\n        !t.name.includes(search) &&\n        !(t.description || '').includes(search)\n      )\n        return false;\n      return true;\n    });\n  }, [templates, search, category]);\n\n  const sorted = useMemo(() => {\n    return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {\n      const aRec = recommendedIds.has(a.id) ? 0 : 1;\n      const bRec = recommendedIds.has(b.id) ? 0 : 1;\n      return aRec - bRec;\n    });\n  }, [filtered, recommendedIds]);\n\n  if (isLoading)\n    return <Spin style={{ display: 'block', margin: '80px auto' }} />;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ maxWidth: 960, margin: '0 auto' }}>\n      {audienceProfile && recommendedIds.size > 0 && (\n        <Card\n          size=\"small\"\n          style={{\n            marginBottom: 16,\n            background: '#fffbe6',\n            borderColor: '#ffe58f',\n          }}\n        >\n          <StarFilled style={{ color: '#faad14', marginRight: 6 }} />\n          <Text>\n            根据受众画像（付费占比{' '}\n            {(audienceProfile.paidRatio * 100).toFixed(0)}%），已为你标记推荐模板\n          </Text>\n        </Card>\n      )}\n\n      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Input.Search\n          placeholder=\"搜索模板名称...\"\n          allowClear\n          value={search}\n          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}\n          style={{ width: 260 }}\n        />\n        <Select\n          value={category}\n          onChange={setCategory}\n          style={{ width: 140 }}\n          options={CATEGORY_OPTIONS}\n        />\n      </div>\n\n      {sorted.length === 0 ? (\n        <Empty description=\"暂无匹配模板\" />\n      ) : (\n        <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>\n          {sorted.map((tpl) => (\n            <Col key={tpl.id} xs={24} sm={12} md={8} lg={6}>\n              <TemplateCard\n                template={tpl}\n                selected={templateId === tpl.id}\n                recommended={recommendedIds.has(tpl.id)}\n                onClick={() => dispatch(setTemplateId(tpl.id))}\n              />\n            </Col>\n          ))}\n        </Row>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';\nimport {\n  Card,\n  Row,\n  Col,\n  Segmented,\n  Descriptions,\n  Alert,\n  Button,\n  Input,\n  Select,\n  Typography,\n  message,\n} from 'antd';\nimport {\n  MailOutlined,\n  WarningOutlined,\n  SendOutlined,\n} from '@ant-design/icons';\nimport { useAppSelector } from '../../../app/store';\nimport { useGetTemplateQuery, useSendTestEmailMutation } from '../campaignApi';\nimport EmailPreview from '../../../components/EmailPreview';\nimport {\n  SEGMENTS,\n  SEGMENT_LABELS,\n  LANGUAGE_MAP,\n} from '../../../utils/constants';\nimport { emptyContentFields, isContentComplete, renderEmailHtml } from '../../../utils/helpers';\nimport type { ContentFields } from '../../../types';\n\nconst { Text } = Typography;\n\nexport default function StepPreviewConfirm() {\n  const { templateId, contents, audienceProfile } = useAppSelector(\n    (s) => s.campaignCreate,\n  );\n\n  const { data: template } = useGetTemplateQuery(templateId ?? '', {\n    skip: !templateId,\n  });\n  const [sendTest, { isLoading: sendingTest }] = useSendTestEmailMutation();\n\n  const currentLangs = useMemo(\n    () => audienceProfile?.topLanguages ?? ['zh-CN'],\n    [audienceProfile],\n  );\n\n  const [previewSegment, setPreviewSegment] = useState('S');\n  const [previewLang, setPreviewLang] = useState(currentLangs[0] ?? 'zh-CN');\n  const [testEmail, setTestEmail] = useState('');\n  const [testSegment, setTestSegment] = useState('S');\n  const [testLang, setTestLang] = useState(currentLangs[0] ?? 'zh-CN');\n\n  const currentContent: ContentFields =\n    contents[previewSegment]?.[previewLang] ?? emptyContentFields();\n\n  const previewHtml = useMemo(() => {\n    if (!template?.html)\n      return '<p style=\"padding:40px;color:#999;text-align:center\">未选择模板</p>';\n    return renderEmailHtml(template.html, currentContent);\n  }, [template, currentContent]);\n\n  const missingLangs = useMemo(() => {\n    const missing: Array<{ segment: string; lang: string; count: number }> = [];\n    if (!audienceProfile) return missing;\n    const audienceLangs = Object.keys(audienceProfile.byLang);\n    for (const seg of SEGMENTS) {\n      for (const lang of audienceLangs) {\n        if (!isContentComplete(contents[seg]?.[lang])) {\n          const count = Math.round(\n            (audienceProfile.byLang[lang] ?? 0) *\n              ((audienceProfile.bySegment[seg] ?? 0) / audienceProfile.total),\n          );\n          if (count > 0) missing.push({ segment: seg, lang, count });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return missing;\n  }, [audienceProfile, contents]);\n\n  const handleSendTest = async () => {\n    if (!testEmail) {\n      message.warning('请输入测试邮箱');\n      return;\n    }\n    try {\n      await sendTest({\n        campaignId: 'draft',\n        email: testEmail,\n        segment: testSegment,\n        lang: testLang,\n      }).unwrap();\n      message.success(`测试邮件已发送至 ${testEmail}`);\n    } catch {\n      message.error('发送失败，请重试');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const segmentOptions = SEGMENTS.map((s) => ({\n    label: SEGMENT_LABELS[s],\n    value: s,\n  }));\n\n  const langOptions = currentLangs.map((c) => ({\n    label: LANGUAGE_MAP[c] ?? c,\n    value: c,\n  }));\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ maxWidth: 960, margin: '0 auto' }}>\n      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Descriptions column={2} size=\"small\" title=\"发送预览\">\n          <Descriptions.Item label=\"模板\">\n            {template?.name ?? '—'}\n          </Descriptions.Item>\n          <Descriptions.Item label=\"收件人\">\n            {audienceProfile\n              ? `${audienceProfile.total.toLocaleString()} 人 (${SEGMENTS.length} 个分层, ${currentLangs.length} 种语言)`\n              : '—'}\n          </Descriptions.Item>\n        </Descriptions>\n      </Card>\n\n      {missingLangs.length > 0 && (\n        <Alert\n          type=\"warning\"\n          showIcon\n          icon={<WarningOutlined />}\n          message=\"缺失语言内容\"\n          description={\n            <div>\n              <Text>以下分层×语言组合尚未编辑内容，部分收件人可能收到空邮件：</Text>\n              <ul style={{ margin: '8px 0', paddingLeft: 20 }}>\n                {missingLangs.slice(0, 8).map((m) => (\n                  <li key={`${m.segment}-${m.lang}`}>\n                    分层 {m.segment} / {LANGUAGE_MAP[m.lang] ?? m.lang} — 约{' '}\n                    {m.count.toLocaleString()} 人\n                  </li>\n                ))}\n                {missingLangs.length > 8 && (\n                  <li>...还有 {missingLangs.length - 8} 个缺失组合</li>\n                )}\n              </ul>\n            </div>\n          }\n          style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      <Card title=\"预览各版本\" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 16, marginBottom: 16, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>\n          <div>\n            <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12, display: 'block', marginBottom: 4 }}>\n              分层\n            </Text>\n            <Segmented\n              options={SEGMENTS.map(String)}\n              value={previewSegment}\n              onChange={(v) => setPreviewSegment(v as string)}\n            />\n          </div>\n          <div>\n            <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12, display: 'block', marginBottom: 4 }}>\n              语言\n            </Text>\n            <Segmented\n              options={currentLangs.map((c) => ({ label: LANGUAGE_MAP[c] ?? c, value: c }))}\n              value={previewLang}\n              onChange={(v) => setPreviewLang(v as string)}\n            />\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {!isContentComplete(contents[previewSegment]?.[previewLang]) && (\n          <Alert\n            type=\"info\"\n            message={`分层 ${previewSegment} / ${LANGUAGE_MAP[previewLang] ?? previewLang} 尚无内容`}\n            style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}\n            showIcon\n          />\n        )}\n\n        <EmailPreview html={previewHtml} />\n      </Card>\n\n      <Card title=\"发送测试邮件\" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Row gutter={12} align=\"bottom\">\n          <Col flex=\"1\">\n            <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12, display: 'block', marginBottom: 4 }}>\n              收件邮箱\n            </Text>\n            <Input\n              prefix={<MailOutlined />}\n              value={testEmail}\n              onChange={(e) => setTestEmail(e.target.value)}\n              placeholder=\"test@example.com\"\n            />\n          </Col>\n          <Col>\n            <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12, display: 'block', marginBottom: 4 }}>\n              分层\n            </Text>\n            <Select\n              value={testSegment}\n              onChange={setTestSegment}\n              options={segmentOptions}\n              style={{ width: 140 }}\n            />\n          </Col>\n          <Col>\n            <Text type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12, display: 'block', marginBottom: 4 }}>\n              语言\n            </Text>\n            <Select\n              value={testLang}\n              onChange={setTestLang}\n              options={langOptions}\n              style={{ width: 120 }}\n            />\n          </Col>\n          <Col>\n            <Button\n              type=\"primary\"\n              icon={<SendOutlined />}\n              loading={sendingTest}\n              onClick={handleSendTest}\n            >\n              发送测试邮件\n            </Button>\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

(\n              <Text strong>{v.toLocaleString()}</Text>\n            ) : (\n              v.toLocaleString()\n            ),\n        },\n        {\n          title: '语言分布',\n          dataIndex: 'langDist',\n          render: (dist: Record<string, number>) =>\n            Object.entries(dist)\n              .filter(([, v]) => v > 0)\n              .map(([lang, count]) => `${LANGUAGE_MAP[lang] ?? lang}:${count}`)\n              .join('  '),\n        },\n      ]}\n    />\n  );\n}\n\ntype SendPhase = 'config' | 'sending' | 'done';\n\nexport default function StepSendSettings() {\n  const dispatch = useAppDispatch();\n  const { sendConfig, audienceProfile } = useAppSelector((s) => s.campaignCreate);\n  const [triggerSend, { isLoading: triggering }] = useTriggerSendMutation();\n\n  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<SendPhase>('config');\n  const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [progress, setProgress] = useState({ sent: 0, total: 0, failed: 0 });\n  const pollingRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);\n\n  const stopPolling = useCallback(() => {\n    if (pollingRef.current) {\n      clearInterval(pollingRef.current);\n      pollingRef.current = null;\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => stopPolling, [stopPolling]);\n\n  const handleConfirmSend = async () => {\n    setConfirmOpen(false);\n    try {\n      await triggerSend({\n        campaignId: 'draft',\n        sendType: sendConfig.type,\n        scheduledAt: sendConfig.scheduledAt,\n      }).unwrap();\n\n      const total = audienceProfile?.total ?? 11500;\n      setProgress({ sent: 0, total, failed: 0 });\n      setPhase('sending');\n\n      let sent = 0;\n      pollingRef.current = setInterval(() => {\n        const batch = Math.floor(Math.random() * 800) + 400;\n        sent = Math.min(total, sent + batch);\n        const failed = Math.floor(sent * 0.003);\n        setProgress({ sent, total, failed });\n        if (sent >= total) {\n          stopPolling();\n          setPhase('done');\n        }\n      }, 600);\n    } catch {\n      message.error('发送请求失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (phase === 'sending') {\n    const pct = Math.round((progress.sent / progress.total) * 100);\n    return (\n      <div style={{ maxWidth: 600, margin: '60px auto', textAlign: 'center' }}>\n        <Title level={4}>发送中...</Title>\n        <Progress\n          type=\"circle\"\n          percent={pct}\n          format={() =>\n            `${progress.sent.toLocaleString()} / ${progress.total.toLocaleString()}`\n          }\n          size={180}\n        />\n        <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>\n          <Text type=\"secondary\">\n            已发送 {progress.sent.toLocaleString()} 封 · 失败 {progress.failed} 封\n          </Text>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (phase === 'done') {\n    return (\n      <Result\n        status=\"success\"\n        title=\"发送完成\"\n        subTitle={`共发送 ${progress.total.toLocaleString()} 封邮件，失败 ${progress.failed} 封`}\n        extra={[\n          <Button\n            key=\"detail\"\n            type=\"primary\"\n            onClick={() => message.info('跳转到活动详情页（待实现）')}\n          >\n            查看活动报表\n          </Button>,\n          <Button key=\"new\" onClick={() => dispatch(resetCampaignCreate())}>\n            创建新活动\n          </Button>,\n        ]}\n      />\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ maxWidth: 700, margin: '0 auto' }}>\n      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Title level={5} style={{ marginTop: 0 }}>\n          发送方式\n        </Title>\n        <Radio.Group\n          value={sendConfig.type}\n          onChange={(e) => dispatch(setSendConfig({ type: e.target.value }))}\n        >\n          <Space direction=\"vertical\">\n            <Radio value=\"immediate\">立即发送</Radio>\n            <Radio value=\"scheduled\">\n              定时发送\n              {sendConfig.type === 'scheduled' && (\n                <DatePicker\n                  showTime\n                  value={sendConfig.scheduledAt ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt) : null}\n                  onChange={(d) =>\n                    dispatch(setSendConfig({ scheduledAt: d?.toISOString() ?? null }))\n                  }\n                  style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}\n                  placeholder=\"选择发送时间\"\n                  disabledDate={(current) => current && current < dayjs().startOf('day')}\n                />\n              )}\n            </Radio>\n          </Space>\n        </Radio.Group>\n      </Card>\n\n      <Card title=\"发送汇总\" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <SendSummaryTable />\n      </Card>\n\n      <Alert\n        type=\"warning\"\n        showIcon\n        icon={<ExclamationCircleFilled />}\n        message={\n          <Text>\n            确认后将发送{' '}\n            <Text strong>{(audienceProfile?.total ?? 0).toLocaleString()}</Text>{' '}\n            封邮件，此操作不可撤销\n          </Text>\n        }\n        style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}\n      />\n\n      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>\n        <Button\n          type=\"primary\"\n          size=\"large\"\n          icon={<SendOutlined />}\n          loading={triggering}\n          onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}\n          disabled={sendConfig.type === 'scheduled' && !sendConfig.scheduledAt}\n        >\n          确认发送\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n\n      <Modal\n        open={confirmOpen}\n        title={\n          <span>\n            <ExclamationCircleFilled style={{ color: '#faad14', marginRight: 8 }} />\n            二次确认\n          </span>\n        }\n        onOk={handleConfirmSend}\n        onCancel={() => setConfirmOpen(false)}\n        okText=\"确认发送\"\n        cancelText=\"取消\"\n        okButtonProps={{ danger: true }}\n      >\n        <p>\n          即将向{' '}\n          <Text strong>{(audienceProfile?.total ?? 0).toLocaleString()}</Text>{' '}\n          位收件人发送邮件。\n        </p>\n        <p>\n          发送方式：\n          <Text strong>\n            {sendConfig.type === 'immediate'\n              ? '立即发送'\n              : `定时发送 (${sendConfig.scheduledAt ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm') : '—'})`}\n          </Text>\n        </p>\n        <p>此操作不可撤销，是否继续？</p>\n      </Modal>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

'请完成当前步骤');\n      return;\n    }\n    dispatch(nextStep());\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Steps\n          current={currentStep}\n          items={STEPS}\n          onChange={(step) => {\n            if (step < currentStep) dispatch(setStep(step));\n          }}\n          style={{ maxWidth: 800, margin: '0 auto' }}\n        />\n      </Card>\n\n      <div style={{ minHeight: 400 }}>\n        <StepContent step={currentStep} />\n      </div>\n\n      {currentStep < 4 && (\n        <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center' }}>\n          <Space size=\"large\">\n            {currentStep > 0 && (\n              <Button onClick={() => dispatch(prevStep())}>上一步</Button>\n            )}\n            <Button onClick={() => message.success('草稿已保存')}>\n              保存草稿\n            </Button>\n            <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleNext}>\n              下一步\n            </Button>\n          </Space>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

});\n  }, [filtered, recommendedIds]);\n\n  if (isLoading)\n    return <Spin style={{ display: 'block', margin: '80px auto' }} />;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ maxWidth: 960, margin: '0 auto' </Text>\n        </Card>\n      )}\n\n      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Input.Search\n          placeholder=\"搜索模板名称...\"\n          allowClear\n          value={search}\n          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}\n          style={{ width: 260 }}\n        />\n        <Select\n          value={category}\n          onChange={setCategory}\n ### 已完成的实现

**Step 2: 选择模板** (`StepTemplate.tsx`)
- 模板卡片网格布局（`Row/Col` 响应式 4 列）

- 选中模板高亮 + 左上角蓝色勾选图标
- **受众驱动推荐**：根据 `audienceProfile.paidRatio` 和分层活跃度自动标记推荐模板（红色「推荐」角标 + 星标），推荐模板排序靠前
- 搜索 + 分类筛选

**Step 3: 编辑内容** (`StepEditContent.tsx` → `StepContent.tsx`)
- **Manual/Auto 模式切换**：顶部 `Segmented` 组件切换
- **受众画像卡片**：随分层 Tab 切换动态显示当前分层的特征、策略建议、付费/计划/活跃数据
- **分层 Tab + 语言 Tab 二维导航**：外层 S/A/B/C 分层卡片 Tab（含完成进度），内层多语言 Tab（含完成状态图标）
- **内容编辑表单**：所有字段（标题/称呼/开场/正文/亮点/CTA/结尾/团队/日期），支持动态添加段落和亮点
- **实时预览 iframe**：`EmailPreview` 组件，将模板 HTML + 内容字段渲染后通过 iframe `srcdoc` 展示，支持 Desktop/Mobile 切换
- **分层埋点配置**：可折叠面板展示 `utm_segment` 参数
- **各分层完成度矩阵**：右侧面板实时显示所有分层×语言的完成状态
- **快捷操作**：内容复制（S→A/B/C）、AI 翻译占位按钮
- **Auto 模式面板**：受众概要、活动素材输入、分层策略配置、生成参数、一键生成按钮

**Step 4: 预览确认** (`StepPreviewConfirm.tsx` → `StepPreview.tsx`)
- 分层×语言 `Segmented` 切换器 + `EmailPreview` 完整预览
- **缺失语言检查**：自动对比受众语言分布与已编辑内容，对缺失组合显示 `Alert` 警告（含影响人数）
- **发送测试邮件**：邮箱输入 + 分层/语言选择 + 发送按钮（Mock API）

- 立即发送 / 定时发送（`DatePicker` 选择时间）
- 发送汇总表格（按分层显示人数和语言分布）

- **二次确认 Modal**（danger 红色确认按钮，显示人数和发送方式）
- **发送进度轮询**：模拟 600ms 间隔更新的 `Progress` 圆环动画
- 发送完成 `Result` 页面

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-frontend\\src\\utils\\sseClient.ts",
 "contents": "export interface SSEEvent {\n  event: string;\n  [key: string]: unknown;\n}\n\nexport async function consumeSSE(\n  url: string,\n  body: Record<string, unknown>,\n  onEvent: (evt: SSEEvent) => void,\n  onDone?: () => void,\n  onError?: (err: Error) => void\n) {\n  try {\n    const response = await fetch(url, {\n      method: 'POST',\n      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n      body: JSON.stringify(body),\n    });\n    if (!response.ok || !response.body) {\n      throw new Error(`SSE request failed: ${response.status}`);\n    }\n    const reader = response.body.getReader();\n    const decoder = new TextDecoder();\n    let buffer = '';\n    while (true) {\n      const { done, value } = await reader.read();\n      if (done) break;\n      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });\n      const lines = buffer.split('\\n');\n      buffer = lines.pop() || '';\n      for (const line of lines) {\n        const trimmed = line.trim();\n        if (!trimmed || !trimmed.startsWith('data:')) continue;\n        try {\n          const data = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(5));\n          onEvent(data as SSEEvent);\n        } catch {\n          // skip malformed events\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    onDone?.();\n  } catch (err) {\n    onError?.(err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)));\n  }\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { Segmented } from 'antd';\n\ninterface EmailPreviewProps {\n  html: string;\n  device?: 'desktop' | 'mobile';\n  onDeviceChange?: (device: 'desktop' | 'mobile') => void;\n  showDeviceSwitch?: boolean;\n  style?: React.CSSProperties;\n}\n\nexport default function EmailPreview({\n  html,\n  device = 'desktop',\n  onDeviceChange,\n  showDeviceSwitch = true,\n  style,\n}: EmailPreviewProps) {\n  const iframeRef = useRef<HTMLIFrameElement>(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (iframeRef.current) {\n      const doc = iframeRef.current.contentDocument;\n      if (doc) {\n        doc.open();\n        doc.write(html || '<p style=\"color:#999;text-align:center;padding:40px\">暂无内容</p>');\n        doc.close();\n      }\n    }\n  }, [html]);\n\n  const width = device === 'desktop' ? 600 : 375;\n\n  return (\n    <div style={style}>\n      {showDeviceSwitch && onDeviceChange && (\n        <div style={{ marginBottom: 12, textAlign: 'center' }}>\n          <Segmented\n            size=\"small\"\n            options={[\n              { label: 'Desktop', value: 'desktop' },\n              { label: 'Mobile', value: 'mobile' },\n            ]}\n            value={device}\n            onChange={(val) => onDeviceChange(val as 'desktop' | 'mobile')}\n          />\n        </div>\n      )}\n      <div\n        style={{\n          width: '100%',\n          overflow: 'auto',\n          display: 'flex',\n          justifyContent: 'center',\n          background: '#f5f5f5',\n          borderRadius: 8,\n          padding: 16,\n          minHeight: 400,\n        }}\n      >\n        <iframe\n          ref={iframeRef}\n          title=\"email-preview\"\n          style={{\n            width,\n            minHeight: 500,\n            border: '1px solid #e8e8e8',\n            borderRadius: 4,\n            background: '#fff',\n            flexShrink: 0,\n          }}\n          sandbox=\"allow-same-origin\"\n        />\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

}

 "contents": "import { Tabs, Badge } from 'antd';\nimport { CheckCircleFilled, ClockCircleFilled, LoadingOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';\nimport type { ContentStatus } from '@/types';\nimport { LANGUAGE_MAP } from '@/utils/constants';\n\ninterface LangTabsProps {\n  langs: string[];\n  activeLang: string;\n  status?: Record<string, ContentStatus>;\n  onChange: (lang: string) => void;\n}\n\nfunction statusIcon(s?: ContentStatus) {\n  if (!s || s === 'pending') return <ClockCircleFilled style={{ color: '#d9d9d9', fontSize: 12 }} />;\n  if (s === 'loading') return <LoadingOutlined style={{ color: '#1677ff', fontSize: 12 }} />;\n  if (s === 'done') return <CheckCircleFilled style={{ color: '#52c41a', fontSize: 12 }} />;\n  return <Badge status=\"error\" />;\n}\n\nexport default function LangTabs({ langs, activeLang, status, onChange }: LangTabsProps) {\n  return (\n    <Tabs\n      size=\"small\"\n      activeKey={activeLang}\n      onChange={onChange}\n      items={langs.map((lang) => ({\n        key: lang,\n        label: (\n          <span>\n            {LANGUAGE_MAP[lang] || lang}\n            {status && <span style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>{statusIcon(status[lang])}</span>}\n          </span>\n        ),\n      }))}\n    />\n  );\n}\n"
}

(\n            <ArrowUpOutlined style={{ color: '#52c41a' }} />\n          ) : trend === 'down' ? (\n            <ArrowDownOutlined style={{ color: '#ff4d4f' }} />\n          ) : undefined\n        }\n      />\n      {trendValue && (\n        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: trend === 'up' ? '#52c41a' : '#ff4d4f', marginTop: 4 }}>\n          {trendValue}\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n"
}

}

  <span>{plan}</span>\n                      <span>{count.toLocaleString()}</span>\n                    </div>\n                  ))}\n                </Card>\n              </Col>\n            </Row>\n\n            <Card type=\"inner\" title=\"抽样预览（前 10 条）\" size=\"small\" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>\n              <Table\n                size=\"small\"\n                dataSource={recipientStats.sample}\n                rowKey=\"email\"\n                pagination={false}\n                columns={[\n                  { title: '邮箱', dataIndex: 'email', key: 'email' },\n                  { title: '分层', dataIndex: 'segment', key: 'segment', render: (s: string) => <SegmentBadge segment={s} /> },\n                  { title: '语言', dataIndex: 'lang', key: 'lang' },\n                  { title: '订阅计划', dataIndex: 'plan', key: 'plan' },\n                ]}\n              />\n            </Card>\n          </Card>\n        )}\n\n        <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>\n          <Space>\n            <Button>保存草稿</Button>\n            <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleNext}>下一步</Button>\n          </Space>\n        </div>\n      </Space>\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n"
}

dispatch(setTemplateId(id));\n  };\n\n  const handleNext = () => {\n    if (!templateId) {\n      message.warning('请选择一个模板');\n      return;\n    }\n    dispatch(nextStep());\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Card title=\"Step 2: 选择模板\">\n      <Space direction=\"vertical\" size=\"large\" style={{ width: '100%' }}>\n        <Space wrap>\n          <Input\n            placeholder=\"搜索模板...\"\n            prefix={<SearchOutlined />}\n            value={search}\n            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}\n            style={{ width: 240 }}\n            allowClear\n          />\n options={TEMPLATE_CATEGORIES}\n          />\n          {audienceProfile && (\n            <Tag color=\"blue\" style={{ lineHeight: '30px' }}>\n              受众：{audienceProfile.total.toLocaleString()} (\n          <Empty description=\"没有匹配的模板\" />\n        ) : (\n          <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>\n            {filteredTemplates.map((tpl) => {\n              const isSelected = templateId === tpl.id;\n              const isRecommended = !!recommendations[tpl.id];\n              const categoryLabel = TEMPLATE_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.value === tpl.category)?.label || tpl.category;\n\n              return (\n                <Col xs={24} sm={12} md={8} lg={6} key={tpl.id}>\n                  <Badge.Ribbon\n                    text={\n                      isRecommended ? }}\n                      styles={{ body: { padding: 12 } }}\n                      cover={\n                        <div\n                          style={{\n                            height:                            position: 'absolute',\n                                top: 8,\n                                right: 8,\n                                width: 28,\n  >\n                              <CheckOutlined style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 14 }} />\n                            </div>\n                          )}\n                        </div>\n                      }\n                    >\n                      <Text strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: 4 }}>{tpl.name}</Text>\n                      <Tag>{categoryLabel}</Tag>\n                   >\n                          {recommendations[tpl.id]}\n                        </Paragraph>\n                      )}\n                    </Card>\n                  </Badge.Ribbon>\n                </Col>\n              );\n            })}\n          </Row>\n        )}\n\n        <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>\n          <Space>\n            <Button </Space>\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n"
