totalForLang / totalRecipients : 0;\n        return { lang, count: Math.round(segCount * ratio) };\n      })\n      .filter((l) => l.count > 0);\n    return { segment: seg, count: segCount, langDist };\n  });\n\n  const handleConfirmSend = useCallback(() => {\n    setConfirmModalOpen(false);\n    dispatch(setSendTaskId('task-mock-001'));\n    dispatch(setSendTaskStatus('queued'));\n    dispatch(setSendProgress({ total: totalRecipients, sent: 0, failed: 0 }));\n\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      dispatch(setSendTaskStatus('sending'));\n    }, 800);\n\n    let sent = 0;\n    const batchSize = Math.ceil(totalRecipients / 20);\n    pollRef.current = setInterval(() => {\n      sent = Math.min(sent + batchSize + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100), totalRecipients);\n      const failed = Math.floor(sent * 0.003);\n      dispatch(setSendProgress({ total: totalRecipients, sent, failed }));\n\n      if (sent >= totalRecipients) {\n        if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current);\n        dispatch(setSendTaskStatus('completed'));\n        message.success('发送完成！');\n      }\n    }, 500);\n  }, [dispatch, totalRecipients]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    return () => {\n      if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleFinish = () => {\n    dispatch(resetCampaignCreate());\n    navigate('/campaigns');\n  };\n\n  if (sendTaskStatus === 'sending' || sendTaskStatus === 'completed' || sendTaskStatus === 'queued') {\n    const progressPercent =\n      sendProgress.total > 0 ? Math.round((sendProgress.sent / sendProgress.total) * 100) : 0;\n\n    return (\n      <Card>\n        {sendTaskStatus === 'completed' ? (\n          <Result\n            status=\"success\"\n            icon={<CheckCircleFilled style={{ color: '#52c41a' }} />}\n            title=\"发送完成\"\n            subTitle={`共发送 ${sendProgress.sent.toLocaleString()} 封邮件，失败 ${sendProgress.failed} 封`}\n            extra={[\n              <Button key=\"list\" type=\"primary\" onClick={handleFinish}>\n                返回活动列表\n              </Button>,\n              <Button key=\"detail\" onClick={() => navigate('/campaigns/camp-001')}>\n                查看活动详情\n              </Button>,\n            ]}\n          />\n        ) : (\n          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '40px 0' }}>\n            <LoadingOutlined style={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#1677ff', marginBottom: 24 }} />\n            <Title level={4}>\n              {sendTaskStatus === 'queued' ? '正在排队...' : '发送中...'}\n            </Title>\n            <Progress\n              percent={progressPercent}\n              status=\"active\"\n              style={{ maxWidth: 400, margin: '0 auto' }}\n            />\n            <div style={{ marginTop: 16, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 32 }}>\n              <Statistic\n                title=\"已发送\"\n                value={sendProgress.sent.toLocaleString()}\n                suffix={`/ ${sendProgress.total.toLocaleString()}`}\n              />\n              <Statistic title=\"失败\" value={sendProgress.failed} valueStyle={{ color: '#ff4d4f' }} />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </Card>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <Card title=\"Step 5: 发送设置\">\n      <Space direction=\"vertical\" size=\"large\" style={{ width: '100%' }}>\n        <div>\n          <Text strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: 12 }}>发送方式</Text>\n          <Radio.Group\n            value={sendConfig.type}\n            onChange={(e) => dispatch(setSendConfig({ type: e.target.value }))}\n          >\n            <Space direction=\"vertical\">\n              <Radio value=\"immediate\">立即发送</Radio>\n              <Radio value=\"scheduled\">\n                定时发送\n                {sendConfig.type === 'scheduled' && (\n                  <Space style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>\n                    <DatePicker\n                      value={sendConfig.scheduledAt ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt) : null}\n                      onChange={(date) =>\n                        dispatch(\n                          setSendConfig({\n                            scheduledAt: date\n                              ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt || undefined)\n                                  .year(date.year())\n                                  .month(date.month())\n                                  .date(date.date())\n                                  .toISOString()\n                              : null,\n                          })\n                        )\n                      }\n                    />\n                    <TimePicker\n                      format=\"HH:mm\"\n                      value={sendConfig.scheduledAt ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt) : null}\n                      onChange={(time) =>\n                        dispatch(\n                          setSendConfig({\n                            scheduledAt: time\n                              ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt || undefined)\n                                  .hour(time.hour())\n                                  .minute(time.minute())\n                                  .toISOString()\n                              : null,\n                          })\n                        )\n                      }\n                    />\n                  </Space>\n                )}\n              </Radio>\n            </Space>\n          </Radio.Group>\n        </div>\n\n        <Card type=\"inner\" title=\"发送汇总\">\n          <Table\n            size=\"small\"\n            dataSource={sendSummary}\n            rowKey=\"segment\"\n            pagination={false}\n            columns={[\n              {\n                title: '分层',\n                dataIndex: 'segment',\n                key: 'segment',\n                width: 100,\n                render: (seg: string) => (\n                  <Tag color={SEGMENT_COLORS[seg]}>{SEGMENT_LABELS[seg] || seg}</Tag>\n                ),\n              },\n              {\n                title: '人数',\n                dataIndex: 'count',\n                key: 'count',\n                width: 100,\n                render: (v: number) => v.toLocaleString(),\n              },\n              {\n                title: '语言分布',\n                dataIndex: 'langDist',\n                key: 'langDist',\n                render: (dist: Array<{ lang: string; count: number }>) => (\n                  <Space size={4} wrap>\n                    {dist.map(({ lang, count }) => (\n                      <Tag key={lang}>\n                        {LANGUAGE_MAP[lang] || lang}: {count.toLocaleString()}\n                      </Tag>\n                    ))}\n                  </Space>\n                ),\n              },\n            ]}\n            summary={() => (\n              <Table.Summary.Row>\n                <Table.Summary.Cell index={0}>\n                  <Text strong>合计</Text>\n                </Table.Summary.Cell>\n                <Table.Summary.Cell index={1}>\n                  <Text strong>{totalRecipients.toLocaleString()}</Text>\n                </Table.Summary.Cell>\n                <Table.Summary.Cell index={2} />\n              </Table.Summary.Row>\n            )}\n          />\n        </Card>\n\n        <Alert\n          type=\"warning\"\n          icon={<ExclamationCircleFilled />}\n          showIcon\n          message={\n            <Text strong>\n              确认后将发送 {totalRecipients.toLocaleString()} 封邮件，此操作不可撤销\n            </Text>\n          }\n        />\n\n        <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>\n          <Space>\n            <Button onClick={() => dispatch(prevStep())}>上一步</Button>\n            <Button\n              type=\"primary\"\n              size=\"large\"\n              icon={<SendOutlined />}\n              onClick={() => setConfirmModalOpen(true)}\n              danger\n            >\n              确认发送\n            </Button>\n          </Space>\n        </div>\n      </Space>\n\n      <Modal\n        open={confirmModalOpen}\n        title={\n          <span>\n            <ExclamationCircleFilled style={{ color: '#faad14', marginRight: 8 }} />\n            确认发送\n          </span>\n        }\n        onCancel={() => setConfirmModalOpen(false)}\n        onOk={handleConfirmSend}\n        okText=\"确认发送\"\n        cancelText=\"取消\"\n        okButtonProps={{ danger: true }}\n      >\n        <Paragraph>你即将发送以下邮件活动：</Paragraph>\n        <ul>\n          <li>活动名称：{campaignName || '（未命名）'}</li>\n          <li>收件人数：{totalRecipients.toLocaleString()} 人</li>\n          <li>分层数：{activeSegments.length} 个</li>\n          <li>语言数：{availableLangs.length} 种</li>\n          <li>\n            发送方式：\n            {sendConfig.type === 'immediate'\n              ? '立即发送'\n              : `定时发送 (${sendConfig.scheduledAt ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt).format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm') : '未设置'})`}\n          </li>\n        </ul>\n        <Alert\n          type=\"error\"\n          message=\"此操作不可撤销，请确认所有内容无误后再发送。\"\n          style={{ marginTop: 16 }}\n        />\n      </Modal>\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n"
}

PayloadAction<{ segments: string[]; langs: string[] }>,\n    ) {\n      const { segments, langs } = action.payload;\n      for (const seg of segments) {\n        if (!state.contents[seg]) state.aiStatus.autoGenerating = action.payload;\n    },\n    setAutoProgress(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<{ segment: string; lang: string; status: AutoProgressStatus }>,\n    ) {\n      const { segment, lang, status } = action.payload;\n      if (!state.aiStatus.autoProgress[segment])\n        state.aiStatus.autoProgress[segment] = {};\n      state.aiStatus.autoProgress[segment][lang] = status;\n    },\n    setSendConfig(\n      state,\n      action: PayloadAction<Partial<CampaignCreateState['sendConfig']>>,\n    ) {\n message.warning('请选择一个模板');\n      return;\n    }\n    dispatch(nextStep());\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Card title=\"Step 2: 选择模板\">\n      <Space direction=\"vertical\" size=\"large\" style={{ width: '2px solid #1677ff' : '1px solid #f0f0f0',\n                        borderRadius: 8,\n                        overflow: 'hidden',\n                      }}\n                      styles={{ body: { padding: 12 } }}\n                      cover={\n                        <div style={{ height: 220, overflow: 'hidden', background: '#fafafa', position: 'relative' }}>\n                          <TemplateThumbnail template={tpl} />\n                          {isSelected && (\n                            <div style={{\n                              position: 'absolute', top: 8, right: 8, width: 28, height: 28,\n                              borderRadius: '50%', background: '#1677ff', display: 'flex',\n                              alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', zIndex: 10,\n                            }}>\n                              <CheckOutlined style={{ color: '#fff', fontSize: 14 }} />\n                            </div>\n                          )}\n                        </div>\n                      }\n                    >\n                      <Text strong style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: 4 }}>{tpl.name}</Text>\n                      <Tag>{categoryLabel}</Tag>\n                      {isRecommended && (\n                        <Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 0 }}>\n                          {recommendations[tpl.id]}\n                        </Paragraph>\n                      )}\n                    </Card>\n                  </Badge.Ribbon>\n                </Col>\n              );\n            })}\n          </Row>\n        )}\n\n        <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>\n          <Space>\n            <Button onClick={() => dispatch(prevStep())}>上一步</Button>\n            <Button>保存草稿</Button>\n            <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleNext}>下一步</Button>\n          </Space>\n        </div>\n      </Space>\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n"

totalForLang / totalRecipients : 0;\n        return { lang, count: Math.round(segCount * ratio) };\n      })\n      .filter((l) => l.count > 0);\n    return { segment: seg, count: segCount, langDist };\n  });\n\n  const handleConfirmSend = useCallback(() => {\n    setConfirmModalOpen(false);\n    dispatch(setSendTaskId('task-mock-001'));\n    dispatch(setSendTaskStatus('queued'));\n    dispatch(setSendProgress({ total: totalRecipients, sent: 0, failed: 0 }));\n\n    setTimeout(() => { dispatch(setSendTaskStatus('sending')); }, 800);\n\n    let sent = 0;\n    const batchSize = Math.ceil(totalRecipients / 20);\n    pollRef.current = setInterval(() => {\n      sent = Math.min(sent + batchSize + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100), totalRecipients);\n      const failed = Math.floor(sent * 0.003);\n      dispatch(setSendProgress({ total: totalRecipients, sent, failed }));\n      if (sent >= totalRecipients) {\n        if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current);\n        dispatch(setSendTaskStatus('completed'));\n        message.success('发送完成！');\n      }\n    }, 500);\n  }, [dispatch, totalRecipients]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    return () => { if (pollRef.current) clearInterval(pollRef.current); };\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleFinish = () => {\n    dispatch(resetCampaignCreate());\n    navigate('/campaigns');\n  };\n\n  if (sendTaskStatus === 'sending' || sendTaskStatus === 'completed' || sendTaskStatus === 'queued') {\n    const progressPercent = sendProgress.total > 0 ? Math.round((sendProgress.sent / sendProgress.total) * 100) : 0;\n\n    return (\n      <Card>\n        {sendTaskStatus === 'completed' ? (\n          <Result\n            status=\"success\"\n            icon={<CheckCircleFilled style={{ color: '#52c41a' }} />}\n            title=\"发送完成\"\n            subTitle={'共发送 ' + sendProgress.sent.toLocaleString() + ' 封邮件，失败 ' + sendProgress.failed + ' 封'}\n            extra={[\n              <Button key=\"list\" type=\"primary\" onClick={handleFinish}>返回活动列表</Button>,\n              <Button key=\"detail\" onClick={() => navigate('/campaigns/1')}>查看活动详情</Button>,\n            ]}\n          />\n        ) : (\n          <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '40px 0' }}>\n            <LoadingOutlined style={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#1677ff', marginBottom: 24 }} />\n            <Title level={4}>{sendTaskStatus === 'queued' ? 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 32 }}>\n              <Statistic title=\"已发送\" value={sendProgress.sent.toLocaleString()} suffix={'/ ' + sendProgress.total.toLocaleString()} />\n              <Statistic title=\"失败\" value={sendProgress.failed} valueStyle={{ color: '#ff4d4f' }} />\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </Card>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <Card title=\"Step 5: 发送设置\">\n      <Space direction=\"vertical\" size=\"large\" style={{ width: '100%' }}>\n        <div>\n          <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 12 }}>发送方式</div>\n          <Radio.Group\n            value={sendConfig.type}\n            onChange={(e: { target: { value: string } }) => dispatch(setSendConfig({ type: e.target.value as 'immediate' | 'scheduled' }))}\n          >\n            <Space direction=\"vertical\">\n              <Radio value=\"immediate\">立即发送</Radio>\n              <Radio value=\"scheduled\">\n                定时发送\n                {sendConfig.type === 'scheduled' && (\n                  <Space style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>\n                    <DatePicker\n                      value={sendConfig.scheduledAt ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt) : null}\n                      onChange={(date: dayjs.Dayjs | null) =>\n                        dispatch(setSendConfig({ scheduledAt: date ? date.startOf('day').toISOString() : null }))\n                      }\n                    />\n                    <TimePicker\n                      format=\"HH:mm\"\n                      value={sendConfig.scheduledAt ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt) : null}\n                      onChange={(time: dayjs.Dayjs | null) => {\n                        if (time) {\n                          const base = sendConfig.scheduledAt ? dayjs(sendConfig.scheduledAt) : dayjs();\n                          dispatch(setSendConfig({\n                            scheduledAt: index={1}><Text strong>{totalRecipients.toLocaleString()}</Text></Table.Summary.Cell>\n                <Table.Summary.Cell index={2} />\n              </Table.Summary.Row>\n            )}\n          />\n        </Card>\n\n        <Alert\n          type=\"warning\"\n          icon={<ExclamationCircleFilled />}\n          showIcon\n          message={'确认后将发送 ' + totalRecipients.toLocaleString() + ' type=\"primary\" size=\"large\" icon={<SendOutlined />} onClick={() => setConfirmModalOpen(true)} danger>\n              确认发送\n            </Button>\n          </Space>\n        </div>\n      </Space>\n\n      <Modal\n        open={confirmModalOpen}\n        title={<><ExclamationCircleFilled style={{ color: '#faad14', marginRight: 8 }} />确认发送</>}\n        onCancel={() => }

## 已完成工作总结

### 1. Step 2 选择模板 (`StepTemplate.tsx`)
- **模板卡片网格布局**：使用 `Row`/`Col` + `Card` 网格展示模板，每张卡片包含 iframe 缩略图预览、模板名称、分类标签
- **受众驱动的推荐标签**：根据 Step 1 的 `audienceProfile`（付费率、主要分层）自动计算推荐模板，使用金色 `Badge.Ribbon` 显示「推荐」标签及推荐理由
- **搜索和分类筛选**：支持按名称搜索和按分类（促销/产品/会员等）过滤
- **选中状态**：点击卡片选中模板，蓝色边框 + 右上角勾号标识

### 2. Step 3 编辑内容 (`StepContent.tsx`)
- **Manual/Auto 模式切换**：顶部 `Segmented` 组件切换两种编辑模式
- **受众画像卡片**：根据当前选中的分层动态展示该分层的用户特征和 AI 建议策略（从 `audienceProfile.segmentProfiles` 读取）
- **分层 Tab + 语言 Tab 二维导航**：外层 `Segmented` 切换分层（S/A/B/C），内层 `LangTabs` 切换语言
- **内容编辑表单**：完整的 `Form` 表单，包含邮件标题、称呼语、开场语、正文段落（可动态添加）、亮点标题/描述/条目、CTA 按钮、结尾语等所有字段
- **实时预览 iframe**：右侧 `EmailPreview` 组件用 iframe + `srcdoc` 实时渲染，支持 Desktop/Mobile 切换
- **分层埋点配置**：展示各分层的 UTM tracking 参数
- **内容完成度矩阵**：右侧面板显示所有分层×语言的完成状态
- **快捷操作**：支持「复制内容到其他分层」和「AI 翻译」
- **AI 辅助生成**：可折叠的 AI 面板，点击生成后 Mock 填充当前分层内容
- **Auto 模式**：左侧输入素材+策略，右侧预览，一键生成按钮（预留 SSE 接口）
- **campaignCreate slice**：完整的 Redux slice，包含所有 Step 1-5 所需的 state 和 actions

### 3. Step 4-5 预览确认 + 发送设置 (`StepPreview.tsx` + `StepSend.tsx`)
- **预览确认页**：活动汇总信息（名称、模板、收件人数、版本数）
- **分层×语言切换预览**：`Segmented` 选择分层+语言，实时查看对应版本的邮件
- **缺失语言检查**：自动对比受众语言和已编辑内容，缺失的用黄色 `Alert` 警告，提供「返回 Step 3 补充」按钮
- **发送测试邮件**：输入邮箱、选择语言版本和分层，点击发送测试
- **发送设置**：`Radio.Group` 选择立即/定时发送，定时模式显示日期+时间选择器
- **发送汇总表格**：按分层展示人数和语言分布

'As our most valued user, you get first access to all new features and exclusive benefits.'\n        : segment === 'A'\n          ? '感谢您一直以来的支持与信任！'\n      : targetLang === 'ja' ? 'いつもご支援ありがとうございます！'\n        : targetLang === 'ko' ? '항상 응원해 주셔서 감사합니다!'\n          : 'Thank you for your continued support!',\n    team_name: 'TapNow Team',\n  };\n}\n\nexport interface AutoGenerateCallbacks {\n  onStrategy: (segment: string, strategy: string) => void;\n  onContentReady: (segment: string, lang: string, content: ContentFields) => void;\n  onProgress: (segment: string, lang: string, status: 'pending' | 'loading' | 'done') => void;\n  onDone: (total: number, completed: number) => void;\n  onError?: (err: Error) => void;\n}\n\nexport async function mockAutoGenerate(\n  params: {\n    material: string;\n    tone: string;\n    ctaUrl: string;\n    audienceProfile: AudienceProfile;\n    segmentStrategies: Record<string, string>;\n  },\n  callbacks: AutoGenerateCallbacks,\n  signal?: AbortSignal,\n): Promise<void> {\n  const { material, tone, ctaUrl, audienceProfile, segmentStrategies } = params;\n  const segments = Object.keys(audienceProfile.bySegment);\n  const langs = audienceProfile.topLanguages;\n  const total = segments.length * langs.length;\n  let completed = 0;\n\n  for (const lang of langs) {\n    for (const seg of segments) {\n      callbacks.onProgress(seg, lang, 'pending');\n    }\n  }\n\n  for (const seg of segments) {\n    if (signal?.aborted) return;\n\n    const strategy = segmentStrategies[seg]\n      || audienceProfile.segmentProfiles[seg]?.suggestedStrategy\n      || '';\n    callbacks.onStrategy(seg, strategy);\n    await delay(300);\n\n    for (const lang of langs) {\n      if (signal?.aborted) return;\n\n      callbacks.onProgress(seg, lang, 'loading');\n      await delay(400 + Math.random() * 400);\n\n      const content = generateContent(seg, lang, material, strategy, tone, ctaUrl);\n      callbacks.onContentReady(seg, lang, content);\n      callbacks.onProgress(seg, lang, 'done');\n      completed++;\n    }\n  }\n\n  callbacks.onDone(total, completed);\n}\n"
}

columns={langColumns}\n                      dataSource={report.byLang}\n                      rowKey=\"lang\"\n                      pagination={false}\n                      size=\"small\"\n                    />\n                  </Col>\n                </Row>\n              ),\n            },\n            {\n              key: 'domain',\n              label: '域名送达',\n              children: (\n                <Table<DomainStat>\n                  columns={domainColumns}\n                  dataSource={domainStats}\n                  rowKey=\"domain\"\n                />\n              ),\n            },\n          ]}\n        />\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

CanvasRenderer,\n]);\n\nconst { Title } = Typography;\n\ntype Metric = 'openRate' | 'clickRate' | 'deliveryRate';\n\nconst METRIC_OPTIONS: Array<{ label: string; value: Metric }> = [\n  { label: useState<string[]>(\n    completedCampaigns.slice(0, 3).map((c) => c.id),\n  );\n  const [metric, setMetric] = useState<Metric>('openRate');\n\n  const selectedTrends = useMemo(\n    () =>\n      mockHistoryTrends\n        .filter((t) => selectedIds.includes(t.campaignId))\n        .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)),\n    [selectedIds],\n  );\n\n  const avgValue = useMemo(() => {\n    if (selectedTrends.length === 0) return 0;\n    return parseFloat(\n      (selectedTrends.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t[metric], 0) / selectedTrends.length).toFixed(1),\n    );\n  }, [selectedTrends, metric]);\n\n  const bestCampaign = useMemo(() => {\n    if (selectedTrends.length === 0) return null;\n    return selectedTrends.reduce((best, cur) => (cur[metric] > best[metric] ? cur : best));\n  }, [selectedTrends, metric]);\n\n  const lineOption = useMemo(() => {\n    const dates = [...new Set(selectedTrends.map((t) => t.date))].sort();\n\n    const series = selectedIds.map((cid, idx) => {\n      const campTrend = selectedTrends.filter((t) => t.campaignId === cid);\n      const campName = mockCampaigns.find((c) => c.id === cid)?.name ?? cid;\n      return {\n        name: campName,\n        type: 'line' as const,\n        smooth: true,\n        symbol: 'circle',\n        symbolSize: 8,\n        data: dates.map((d) => {\n          const point = campTrend.find((t) => t.date === d);\n {\n                silent: true,\n                data: [\n                  {\n                    yAxis: avgValue,\n                    label: { formatter: `均值 ${avgValue}%`, position:   });\n\n    return {\n      tooltip: {\n        trigger: 'axis' as const,\n        formatter(\n          params: Array<{ seriesName: string; value: number | null; color: string }>,\n        ) {\n          const lines = params\n            .filter((p) => p.value != null)\n            .map(\n              (p) =>\n                `<span lines.join('<br/>');\n        },\n      },\n      legend: {\n        data: selectedIds.map(\n          (cid) => mockCampaigns.find((c) => c.id === cid)?.name ?? cid,\n        ),\n        bottom: 0,\n      },\n      grid: { left: 40, right: 20, top: 40, bottom: 60, containLabel: true },\n      xAxis: {\n        type: 'category' as const,\n        data: dates,\n        axisLabel: { formatter: (v: Math.floor(value.min - 3)),\n      },\n      series,\n    };\n  }, [selectedIds, selectedTrends, metric, avgValue]);\n\n  const metricLabel = METRIC_OPTIONS.find((m) => m.value === metric)?.label ?? '';\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Title level={4} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        历史趋势对比\n      </Title>\n\n      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Row gutter={16} align=\"middle\">\n          <Col flex=\"auto\">\n            <span style={{ marginRight: 8, fontWeight: 500 }}>选择活动：</span>\n            <Select\n              mode=\"multiple\"\n              style={{ minWidth: 400 }}\n              placeholder=\"选择要对比的活动（可多选）\"\n              value={selectedIds}\n              onChange={setSelectedIds}\n              maxTagCount={3}\n              options={completedCampaigns.map((c) => ({\n                label: `${c.name}（${c.scheduledAt?.slice(0, 10) ?? '-'}）`,\n                value: c.id,\n              }))}\n            />\n          </Col>\n          <Col>\n            <Segmented\n              options={METRIC_OPTIONS}\n              value={metric}\n              onChange={(v) => setMetric(v as Metric)}\n            />\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n      </Card>\n\n      {selectedIds.length > 0 && (\n        <Row gutter={12} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n          <Col xs={12} sm={8}>\n            <StatCard title={`平均${metricLabel}`} value={avgValue} suffix=\"%\" />\n          </Col>\n          <Col xs={12} sm={8}>\n            <StatCard title=\"对比活动数\" value={selectedIds.length} />\n          </Col>\n          <Col xs={12} sm={8}>\n            <StatCard\n              title={`最佳${metricLabel}`}\n              value={bestCampaign ? bestCampaign[metric] : '-'}\n              suffix={bestCampaign ? '%' : undefined}\n            />\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n      )}\n\n      <Card>\n        {selectedIds.length === 0 ? (\n          <Empty description=\"请选择至少一个活动进行对比\" />\n        ) : (\n          <ReactEChartsCore\n            echarts={echarts}\n            option={lineOption}\n            style={{ height: 420 }}\n            notMerge\n          />\n        )}\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

marginBottom: 8, marginTop: 0 }}>\n        {tpl.name}\n      </Title>\n      <Paragraph\n        type=\"secondary\"\n        ellipsis={{ rows: 2 }}\n        style={{ marginBottom: 12, flex: 1 }}\n      >\n        {tpl.description}\n      </Paragraph>\n      <Space size={4} wrap>\n        {tpl.tags.map((tag) => (\n          <Tag key={tag} style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>\n            {tag}\n          </Tag>\n        ))}\n      </Space>\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function TemplateListPage() {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');\n  const    <Button\n            type=\"primary\"\n            icon={<PlusOutlined />}\n            onClick={() => navigate('/templates/tpl-blank/edit')}\n          >\n            新建模板\n          </Button>\n        }\n        style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n      >\n        <Space wrap style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n          <Select\n            placeholder=\"分类筛选\"\n            allowClear\n            style={{ width: 160 }}\n            value={category}\n            onChange={setCategory}\n            options={TEMPLATE_CATEGORIES}\n          />\n          <Search\n            placeholder=\"搜索模板名称/标签...\"\n            allowClear\n            style={{ width: 280 }}\n            value={search}\n            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}\n          />\n        </Space>\n\n        {filtered.length === 0 ? const csv = [\n      `活动报表: ${campaign.name}`,\n      '',\n      '=== 总览 ===',\n      `发送量,${report.totalSent}`,\n      `送达率,${report.deliveryRate}%`,\n      `打开率,${report.openRate}%`,\n   <Button icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />} onClick={() => navigate(-1)}>\n          返回\n        </Button>\n        <Title level={4} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n          {campaign.name}\n        </Title>\n        <StatusTag status={campaign.status} />\n      </Space>\n\n      <Row gutter={[12, 12]} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Col xs={12} sm={6}><StatCard title=\"发送量\" defaultActiveKey=\"segment\"\n          tabBarExtraContent={\n            <Button icon={<DownloadOutlined />} onClick={handleExportCSV}>\n              导出 CSV\n            </Button>\n          }\n [selectedIds],\n  );\n\n  const avgValue = useMemo(() => {\n    if (selectedTrends.length === 0) return 0;\n    return parseFloat(\n      (selectedTrends.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t[metric], 0) /     yAxis: avgValue,\n                    label: { formatter: `均值 ${avgValue}%`, position: 'insideEndTop' as const },\n                    lineStyle: { type: 'dashed' as const, color: '#999' },\n                  },\n                ],\n              }\n            : undefined,\n      };\n    });\n\n    return {\n      tooltip: {\n        trigger: 'axis' as const,\n        // style=\"display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:${p.color};margin-right:6px\"></span>${p.seriesName}: ${p.value}%`,\n            );\n          return     },\n      grid: { left: 40, right: 20, top: 40, bottom: 60, containLabel: true },\n      xAxis: {\n        type: 'category' as const,\n        data: dates,\n        axisLabel: { formatter: (v: string) => v.slice(5) },\n      },\n      yAxis: {\n        type: 'value' as const,\n        axisLabel: { formatter: '{value}%' },\n      },\n      series,\n    };\n  }, [selectedIds, selectedTrends, '';\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Title level={4} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        历史趋势对比\n      </Title>\n\n      <Card style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n        <Row gutter={16} align=\"middle\">\n          <Col flex=\"auto\">\n            <span style={{ marginRight: 8, fontWeight: 500 }}>选择活动：</span>\n            <Select\n              mode=\"multiple\"\n              style={{ minWidth: 400 }}\n              placeholder=\"选择要对比的活动（可多选）\"\n              value={selectedIds}\n              onChange={setSelectedIds}\n              maxTagCount={3}\n              options={completedCampaigns.map((c) => ({\n                label: `${c.name}（${c.scheduledAt?.slice(0, 10) ?? '-'}）`,\n                value: c.id,\n              }))}\n            />\n          </Col>\n          <Col>\n            <Segmented\n              options={METRIC_OPTIONS}\n              value={metric}\n              onChange={(v) => setMetric(v as Metric)}\n            />\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n      </Card>\n\n      {selectedIds.length > 0 && (\n        <Row gutter={12} style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n          <Col xs={12} sm={8}>\n            <StatCard title={`平均${metricLabel}`} value={avgValue} suffix=\"%\" />\n          </Col>\n          <Col xs={12} sm={8}>\n            <StatCard title=\"对比活动数\" value={selectedIds.length} />\n          </Col>\n          <Col xs={12} sm={8}>\n            <StatCard\n              title={`最佳${metricLabel}`}\n              value={bestCampaign ? bestCampaign[metric] : '-'}\n              suffix={bestCampaign ? '%' : undefined}\n            />\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n      )}\n\n      <Card>\n        {selectedIds.length === 0 ? (\n          <Empty description=\"请选择至少一个活动进行对比\" />\n        ) : (\n          <ReactEChartsCore\n            echarts={echarts}\n            option={lineOption}\n            style={{ height: 420 }}\n            notMerge\n          />\n        )}\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

(\n            <img\n              src={tpl.thumbnail || tpl.thumbnailUrl}\n              alt={tpl.name}\n              style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }}\n            />\n          ) : (\n            <FileTextOutlined style={{ fontSize: 48, color: '#b0bec5' }} />\n          )}\n          <Tag\n            color={CATEGORY_COLOR[tpl.category] ?? 'default'}\n            style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 8, right: 8 }}\n          >\n            {tpl.category}\n          </Tag>\n          {tpl.status === 'inactive' && (\n            <Tag color=\"default\" style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 8, left: 8 }}>\n              已停用\n            </Tag>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      }\n      actions={[\n        <Button\n          key=\"edit\"\n          type=\"link\"\n          icon={<EditOutlined />}\n          onClick={onEdit}\n        >\n          编辑\n        </Button>,\n      ]}\n    >\n      <Title level={5} style={{ marginBottom: 8, marginTop: 0 }}>\n        {tpl.name}\n      </Title>\n      {tpl.description && (\n        <Paragraph\n          type=\"secondary\"\n          ellipsis={{ rows: 2 }}\n          style={{ marginBottom: 8, flex: 1 }}\n        >\n          {tpl.description}\n        </Paragraph>\n      )}\n      {tpl.tags && tpl.tags.length > 0 && (\n        <Space size={4} wrap style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>\n          {tpl.tags.map((tag) => (\n            <Tag key={tag} style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>{tag}</Tag>\n          ))}\n        </Space>\n      )}\n      {tpl.createdAt && (\n        <Paragraph type=\"secondary\" style={{ marginBottom: 0, fontSize: 12 }}>\n          创建时间: {tpl.createdAt.slice(0, 10)}\n        </Paragraph>\n      )}\n    </Card>\n  );\n}\n\nexport default function TemplateListPage() {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');\n  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);\n\n  const filtered = useMemo(() => {\n    let list: Template[] = mockTemplates;\n    if (category) {\n      list = list.filter((t) => t.category === category);\n    }\n    if (search.trim()) {\n      const kw = search.trim().toLowerCase();\n      list = list.filter(\n        (t) =>\n          t.name.toLowerCase().includes(kw) ||\n          t.id.toLowerCase().includes(kw) ||\n          (t.description ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(kw) ||\n          (t.tags ?? []).some((tag) => tag.toLowerCase().includes(kw)),\n      );\n    }\n    return list;\n  }, [search, category]);\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <Card\n        title={\n          <Title level={4} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n            模板管理\n          </Title>\n        }\n        extra={\n          <Button\n            type=\"primary\"\n            icon={<PlusOutlined />}\n            onClick={() => navigate('/templates/new/edit')}\n          >\n            新建模板\n          </Button>\n        }\n        style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n      >\n        <Space wrap style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>\n          <Select\n            placeholder=\"分类筛选\"\n            allowClear\n            style={{ width: 160 }}\n            value={category}\n            onChange={setCategory}\n            options={TEMPLATE_CATEGORIES}\n          />\n          <Search\n            placeholder=\"搜索模板名称...\"\n            allowClear\n            style={{ width: 280 }}\n            value={search}\n            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}\n          />\n        </Space>\n\n        {filtered.length === 0 ? (\n          <Empty description=\"没有找到匹配的模板\" />\n        ) : (\n          <Row gutter={[16, 16]}>\n            {filtered.map((tpl) => (\n              <Col key={tpl.id} xs={24} sm={12} md={8} lg={6}>\n                <TemplateCard\n                  tpl={tpl}\n                  onEdit={() => navigate(`/templates/${tpl.id}/edit`)}\n                />\n              </Col>\n            ))}\n          </Row>\n        )}\n      </Card>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

padding: 0; font-family: sans-serif; background: #f5f5f5; }\n    .wrapper { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; background: #fff; }\n    .header { background: #1677ff; padding: 40px 30px; text-align: center; color: #fff; }\n    .header h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; }\n    .body { padding: 30px; }\n    .body p { color: #333; line-height: 1.8; }\n    .cta { text-align: center; padding: 20px 0; }\n    .cta a { display: inline-block; background: #1677ff; color: #fff; padding: 14px 40px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }\n    .footer { background: #f8f9fa; padding: 20px 30px; text-align: center; color: #999; font-size: 12px; }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n  <div class=\"wrapper\">\n    <div class=\"header\">\n      <h1>{{email_title}}</h1>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"body\">\n      <p>{{greeting}}</p>\n      <p>{{intro_line}}</p>\n      <div class=\"cta\">\n        <a href=\"{{cta_url}}\">{{cta_text}}</a>\n      </div>\n      <p>{{closing_text}}</p>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"footer\">\n      <p>{{team_name}} &middot; {{send_date}}</p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</body>\n</html>`;\n\nexport default function TemplateEditPage() {\n  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const template = mockTemplates.find((t) => t.id === id);\n\n  const [name, setName] = useState(template?.name ?? DEFAULT_BLANK_HTML);\n  const [device, setDevice] = useState<'desktop' | 'mobile'>('desktop');\n\n  const variables = useMemo(() => extractVariables(html), [html]);\n  const previewWidth = device === 'desktop' ? 600 : 375;\n\n  const handleEditorChange = useCallback((value: string | undefined) => {\n    setHtml(value ?? '');\n  }, []);\n\n  function handleSave() {\n    if (!name.trim()) {\n      message.warning('请输入模板名称');\n      return;\n    }\n    message.success('模板保存成功（Demo 模式）');\n  }\n\n  function handleCopyHtml() {\n    navigator.clipboard.writeText(html).then(\n      () => message.success('HTML 已复制到剪贴板'),\n      () => message.error('复制失败'),\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: 'calc(100vh - 120px)' }}>\n      <Card size=\"small\" style={{ marginBottom: 12, flexShrink: 0 }}>\n        <Row gutter={16} align=\"middle\">\n          <Col>\n            <Button icon={<ArrowLeftOutlined />} onClick={() => navigate('/templates')}>\n              返回\n            </Button>\n          </Col>\n          <Col flex=\"auto\">\n            <Space>\n              <Input\n                value={name}\n                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}\n                placeholder=\"模板名称\"\n                style={{ width: 240 }}\n              />\n              <Select\n                value={category}\n                onChange={setCategory}\n                style={{ width: 140 }}\n                options={TEMPLATE_CATEGORIES}\n              />\n            </Space>\n          </Col>\n          <Col>\n            <Space>\n              <Button icon={<CopyOutlined />} onClick={handleCopyHtml}>\n                复制 HTML\n              </Button>\n              <Button type=\"primary\" icon={<SaveOutlined />} onClick={handleSave}>\n                保存\n              </Button>\n            </Space>\n          </Col>\n        </Row>\n      </Card>\n\n      <Row gutter={12} style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>\n        <Col span={13} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' }}>\n          <Card\n            size=\"small\"\n            title={\n              <Title level={5} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n                HTML 编辑器\n              </Title>\n            }\n            style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}\n            styles={{ body: { flex: 1, padding: 0, minHeight: 0 } }}\n          >\n            <Editor\n              height=\"100%\"\n              defaultLanguage=\"html\"\n              value={html}\n              onChange={handleEditorChange}\n              theme=\"vs-dark\"\n              options={{\n                minimap: { enabled: false },\n                fontSize: 13,\n                wordWrap: 'on',\n                scrollBeyondLastLine: false,\n                automaticLayout: true,\n                tabSize: 2,\n              }}\n            />\n          </Card>\n\n          <Card\n            size=\"small\"\n            style={{ marginTop: 12, flexShrink: 0 }}\n            title={\n              <Space>\n                <Text strong>模板变量</Text>\n                <Text type=\"secondary\">（自动从 HTML 中提取）</Text>\n              </Space>\n            }\n          >\n            {variables.length === 0 ? (\n              <Text type=\"secondary\">\n                未检测到变量。使用 {'{{变量名}}'} 语法插入变量。\n              </Text>\n            ) : (\n              <Space wrap>\n                {variables.map((v) => (\n                  <Tag key={v} color=\"blue\" style={{ cursor: 'default' }}>\n                    {`{{${v}}}`}\n                  </Tag>\n                ))}\n              </Space>\n            )}\n          </Card>\n        </Col>\n\n        <Col span={11} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' }}>\n          <Card\n            size=\"small\"\n            title={\n              <Space>\n                <Title level={5} style={{ margin: 0 }}>\n                  实时预览\n                </Title>\n                <Segmented\n                  size=\"small\"\n                  options={[\n                    { label: <DesktopOutlined />, value: 'desktop' },\n                    { label: <MobileOutlined />, value: 'mobile' },\n                  ]}\n                  value={device}\n                  onChange={(v) => setDevice(v as 'desktop' | 'mobile')}\n                />\n              </Space>\n            }\n            style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}\n            styles={{\n              body: {\n                flex: 1,\n                minHeight: 0,\n                overflow: 'auto',\n ## 实现总结

### Phase 3.1: 统计报表 (`CampaignReportPage`)

**文件**: `src/features/reports/pages/CampaignReportPage.tsx`

- **8 个 StatCard 指标卡片**: 发送量、送达率、打开率、点击率、退信量、退订量、投诉量、点击转化率
- **4 个分析 Tab**:
  - **分层对比**: ECharts 分组柱状图（送达率/打开率/点击率/点击转化率 by segment）+ 数据表格
  - **语言分布**: ECharts 环形饼图（各语言发送量占比）+ 详细数据表格（含动态计算的占比列）
  - **域名送达**: 表格展示各邮箱域名的送达率/打开率/点击率
  - **时间趋势**: ECharts 面积折线图（发送后 72h 的打开率/点击率累计曲线）
- **CSV 导出**: 一键导出包含总览、分层对比、语言分布、域名送达的完整 CSV 文件（UTF-8 BOM 编码）
- **增强 CampaignDetailPage**: 报表 Tab 现在包含柱状图和"查看完整报表"按钮

### Phase 3.2: 历史趋势 (`HistoryTrendPage`)

**文件**: `src/features/reports/pages/HistoryTrendPage.tsx`

- **多活动选择器**: Select 多选组件，筛选已完成的活动进行对比
- **指标切换**: Segmented 组件切换打开率/点击率/送达率
- **3 个汇总 StatCard**: 平均值、对比活动数、最佳值
- **折线图纵向对比**: 每个选中活动一条线，包含均值参考虚线（markLine），支持 tooltip 显示详情

### Phase 4.1: 模板管理 (`TemplateListPage` + `TemplateEditPage`)

**文件**: `src/features/templates/pages/TemplateListPage.tsx`

- **卡片网格布局**: 响应式 Row/Col 布局，每张卡片展示缩略图、分类标签、名称、描述、创建时间
- **筛选功能**: 按分类下拉筛选 + 关键词搜索
- **新建入口**: "新建模板"按钮跳转编辑页

**文件**: `src/features/templates/pages/TemplateEditPage.tsx`

- **Monaco 编辑器**: 左侧 HTML 代码编辑器，支持语法高亮、自动换行、暗色主题
- **实时预览**: 右侧 iframe 预览，支持 Desktop（600px）/ Mobile（375px）切换
- **变量自动提取**: 从 HTML 中正则提取 `{{xxx}}` 变量，以蓝色 Tag 展示
- **工具栏**: 模板名称编辑、分类选择、复制 HTML、保存功能

 "contents": "import { useAuth } from './useAuth';\nimport type { UserRole } from '@/types';\n\nconst ROUTE_PERMISSIONS: Record<string, UserRole[]> = {\n  '/settings/users': ['admin'],\n  '/templates/:id/edit': ['admin'],\n};\n\nexport function usePermission() {\n  const { role } = useAuth();\n\n  const hasAccess = (path: string): boolean => {\n    if (!role) return false;\n    const requiredRoles = Object.entries(ROUTE_PERMISSIONS).find(([pattern]) => {\n      const regex = new RegExp('^' + pattern.replace(/:[^/]+/g, '[^/]+') + '$');\n      return regex.test(path);\n    });\n    if (!requiredRoles) return true;\n    return requiredRoles[1].includes(role);\n  };\n\n  const isAdmin = role === 'admin';\n\n  return { hasAccess, isAdmin, role };\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-frontend\\src\\features\\unsubscribe\\unsubscribeApi.ts",
 "contents": "import { createApi, fakeBaseQuery } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';\nimport { mockUnsubscribes } from '@/mocks/unsubscribes';\nimport type { UnsubscribeRecord } from '@/types';\n\nlet localData = [...mockUnsubscribes];\nlet nextId = localData.length + 1;\n\ninterface ListParams {\n  page: number;\n  pageSize: number;\n  keyword?: string;\n  source?: string;\n}\n\nexport const unsubscribeApi = createApi({\n  reducerPath: 'unsubscribeApi',\n  baseQuery: fakeBaseQuery(),\n  tagTypes: ['Unsubscribe'],\n  endpoints: (builder) => ({\n    listUnsubscribes: builder.query<\n      { items: UnsubscribeRecord[]; total: number },\n      ListParams\n    >({\n      queryFn: ({ page, pageSize, keyword, source }) => {\n        let filtered = [...localData];\n        if (keyword) {\n          const kw = keyword.toLowerCase();\n          filtered = filtered.filter(\n            (r) =>\n              r.email.toLowerCase().includes(kw) ||\n              r.reason.toLowerCase().includes(kw),\n          );\n        }\n        if (source && source !== 'all') {\n          filtered = filtered.filter((r) => r.source === source);\n        }\n        filtered.sort(\n          (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime(),\n        );\n        const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;\n        return {\n          data: {\n            items: filtered.slice(start, start + pageSize),\n            total: filtered.length,\n          },\n        };\n      },\n      providesTags: ['Unsubscribe'],\n    }),\n\n    addUnsubscribe: builder.mutation<UnsubscribeRecord, { email: string; reason: string }>({\n      queryFn: ({ email, reason }) => {\n        const exists = localData.find((r) => r.email === email);\n        if (exists) {\n          return { error: { status: 409, data: '该邮箱已在退订列表中' } };\n        }\n        const record: UnsubscribeRecord = {\n          id: `unsub-${String(nextId++).padStart(3, '0')}`,\n          email,\n          reason,\n          source: 'manual',\n          campaignId: null,\n          campaignName: null,\n          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        };\n        localData.unshift(record);\n        return { data: record };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['Unsubscribe'],\n    }),\n\n    batchImportUnsubscribes: builder.mutation<\n      { imported: number; duplicates: number },\n      string[]\n    >({\n      queryFn: (emails) => {\n        let imported = 0;\n        let duplicates = 0;\n        for (const email of emails) {\n          const trimmed = email.trim().toLowerCase();\n          if (!trimmed || !/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(trimmed)) continue;\n          if (localData.find((r) => r.email.toLowerCase() === trimmed)) {\n            duplicates++;\n            continue;\n          }\n          localData.unshift({\n            id: `unsub-${String(nextId++).padStart(3, '0')}`,\n            email: trimmed,\n            reason: 'CSV 批量导入',\n            source: 'csv_import',\n            campaignId: null,\n            campaignName: null,\n            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          });\n          imported++;\n        }\n        return { data: { imported, duplicates } };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['Unsubscribe'],\n    }),\n\n    removeUnsubscribe: builder.mutation<void, string>({\n      queryFn: (id) => {\n        localData = localData.filter((r) => r.id !== id);\n        return { data: undefined };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['Unsubscribe'],\n    }),\n  }),\n});\n\nexport const {\n  useListUnsubscribesQuery,\n  useAddUnsubscribeMutation,\n  useBatchImportUnsubscribesMutation,\n  useRemoveUnsubscribeMutation,\n} = unsubscribeApi;\n"
}

 "contents": "import { createApi, fakeBaseQuery } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';\nimport { mockUsers } from '@/mocks/users';\nimport type { SystemUser, UserRole } from '@/types';\n\nlet localData = [...mockUsers];\nlet nextId = localData.length + 1;\n\ninterface ListParams {\n  page: number;\n  pageSize: number;\n  keyword?: string;\n  role?: string;\n  status?: string;\n}\n\nexport const settingsApi = createApi({\n  reducerPath: 'settingsApi',\n  baseQuery: fakeBaseQuery(),\n  tagTypes: ['SystemUser'],\n  endpoints: (builder) => ({\n    listUsers: builder.query<{ items: SystemUser[]; total: number }, ListParams>({\n      queryFn: ({ page, pageSize, keyword, role, status }) => {\n        let filtered = [...localData];\n        if (keyword) {\n          const kw = keyword.toLowerCase();\n          filtered = filtered.filter(\n            (u) =>\n              u.name.toLowerCase().includes(kw) ||\n              u.email.toLowerCase().includes(kw),\n          );\n        }\n        if (role && role !== 'all') {\n          filtered = filtered.filter((u) => u.role === role);\n        }\n        if (status && status !== 'all') {\n          filtered = filtered.filter((u) => u.status === status);\n        }\n        filtered.sort(\n          (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime(),\n        );\n        const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;\n        return {\n          data: {\n            items: filtered.slice(start, start + pageSize),\n            total: filtered.length,\n          },\n        };\n      },\n      providesTags: ['SystemUser'],\n    }),\n\n    inviteUser: builder.mutation<\n      SystemUser,\n      { name: string; email: string; role: UserRole }\n    >({\n      queryFn: ({ name, email, role }) => {\n        const exists = localData.find((u) => u.email === email);\n        if (exists) {\n          return { error: { status: 409, data: '该邮箱已存在' } };\n        }\n        const user: SystemUser = {\n          id: `u-${String(nextId++).padStart(3, '0')}`,\n          name,\n          email,\n          role,\n          status: 'active',\n          lastLoginAt: null,\n          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        };\n        localData.unshift(user);\n        return { data: user };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['SystemUser'],\n    }),\n\n    updateUserRole: builder.mutation<void, { id: string; role: UserRole }>({\n      queryFn: ({ id, role }) => {\n        const user = localData.find((u) => u.id === id);\n        if (!user) return { error: { status: 404, data: '用户不存在' } };\n        user.role = role;\n        return { data: undefined };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['SystemUser'],\n    }),\n\n    toggleUserStatus: builder.mutation<void, string>({\n      queryFn: (id) => {\n        const user = localData.find((u) => u.id === id);\n        if (!user) return { error: { status: 404, data: '用户不存在' } };\n        user.status = user.status === 'active' ? 'disabled' : 'active';\n        return { data: undefined };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['SystemUser'],\n    }),\n  }),\n});\n\nexport const {\n  useListUsersQuery,\n  useInviteUserMutation,\n  useUpdateUserRoleMutation,\n  useToggleUserStatusMutation,\n} = settingsApi;\n"
}

}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\EDM\\edm-frontend\\src\\features\\unsubscribe\\unsubscribeApi.ts",
 "contents": "import { createApi, fakeBaseQuery } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';\nimport { mockUnsubscribes } from '../../mocks/unsubscribes';\nimport type { UnsubscribeRecord } from '../../types';\n\nlet localData = [...mockUnsubscribes];\nlet nextId = localData.length + 1;\n\ninterface ListParams {\n  page: number;\n  pageSize: number;\n  keyword?: string;\n  source?: string;\n}\n\nexport const unsubscribeApi = createApi({\n  reducerPath: 'unsubscribeApi',\n  baseQuery: fakeBaseQuery(),\n  tagTypes: ['Unsubscribe'],\n  endpoints: (builder) => ({\n    listUnsubscribes: builder.query<\n      { items: UnsubscribeRecord[]; total: number },\n      ListParams\n    >({\n      queryFn: ({ page, pageSize, keyword, source }) => {\n        let filtered = [...localData];\n        if (keyword) {\n          const kw = keyword.toLowerCase();\n          filtered = filtered.filter(\n            (r) =>\n              r.email.toLowerCase().includes(kw) ||\n              r.reason.toLowerCase().includes(kw),\n          );\n        }\n        if (source && source !== 'all') {\n          filtered = filtered.filter((r) => r.source === source);\n        }\n        filtered.sort(\n          (a, b) =>\n            new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime(),\n        );\n        const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;\n        return {\n          data: {\n            items: filtered.slice(start, start + pageSize),\n            total: filtered.length,\n          },\n        };\n      },\n      providesTags: ['Unsubscribe'],\n    }),\n\n    addUnsubscribe: builder.mutation<\n      UnsubscribeRecord,\n      { email: string; reason: string }\n    >({\n      queryFn: ({ email, reason }) => {\n        const exists = localData.find((r) => r.email === email);\n        if (exists) {\n          return { error: { status: 409, data: '该邮箱已在退订列表中' } };\n        }\n        const record: UnsubscribeRecord = {\n          id: `unsub-${String(nextId++).padStart(3, '0')}`,\n          email,\n          reason,\n          source: 'manual',\n          campaignId: null,\n          campaignName: null,\n          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        };\n        localData.unshift(record);\n        return { data: record };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['Unsubscribe'],\n    }),\n\n    batchImportUnsubscribes: builder.mutation<\n      { imported: number; duplicates: number },\n      string[]\n    >({\n      queryFn: (emails) => {\n        let imported = 0;\n        let duplicates = 0;\n        for (const email of emails) {\n          const trimmed = email.trim().toLowerCase();\n          if (!trimmed || !/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(trimmed)) continue;\n          if (localData.find((r) => r.email.toLowerCase() === trimmed)) {\n            duplicates++;\n            continue;\n          }\n          localData.unshift({\n            id: `unsub-${String(nextId++).padStart(3, '0')}`,\n            email: trimmed,\n            reason: 'CSV 批量导入',\n            source: 'csv_import',\n            campaignId: null,\n            campaignName: null,\n            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          });\n          imported++;\n        }\n        return { data: { imported, duplicates } };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['Unsubscribe'],\n    }),\n\n    removeUnsubscribe: builder.mutation<void, string>({\n      queryFn: (id) => {\n        localData = localData.filter((r) => r.id !== id);\n        return { data: undefined };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['Unsubscribe'],\n    }),\n  }),\n});\n\nexport const {\n  useListUnsubscribesQuery,\n  useAddUnsubscribeMutation,\n  useBatchImportUnsubscribesMutation,\n  useRemoveUnsubscribeMutation,\n} = unsubscribeApi;\n"
}

 "contents": "import { createApi, fakeBaseQuery } from '@reduxjs/toolkit/query/react';\nimport { mockUsers } from '../../mocks/users';\nimport type { SystemUser, UserRole } from '../../types';\n\nlet localData = [...mockUsers];\nlet nextId = localData.length + 1;\n\ninterface ListParams {\n  page: number;\n  pageSize: number;\n  keyword?: string;\n  role?: string;\n  status?: string;\n}\n\nexport const settingsApi = createApi({\n  reducerPath: 'settingsApi',\n  baseQuery: fakeBaseQuery(),\n  tagTypes: ['SystemUser'],\n  endpoints: (builder) => ({\n    listUsers: builder.query<\n      { items: SystemUser[]; total: number },\n      ListParams\n    >({\n      queryFn: ({ page, pageSize, keyword, role, status }) => {\n        let filtered = [...localData];\n        if (keyword) {\n          const kw = keyword.toLowerCase();\n          filtered = filtered.filter(\n            (u) =>\n              u.name.toLowerCase().includes(kw) ||\n              u.email.toLowerCase().includes(kw),\n          );\n        }\n        if (role && role !== 'all') {\n          filtered = filtered.filter((u) => u.role === role);\n        }\n        if (status && status !== 'all') {\n          filtered = filtered.filter((u) => u.status === status);\n        }\n        filtered.sort(\n          (a, b) =>\n            new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime(),\n        );\n        const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;\n        return {\n          data: {\n            items: filtered.slice(start, start + pageSize),\n            total: filtered.length,\n          },\n        };\n      },\n      providesTags: ['SystemUser'],\n    }),\n\n    inviteUser: builder.mutation<\n      SystemUser,\n      { name: string; email: string; role: UserRole }\n    >({\n      queryFn: ({ name, email, role }) => {\n        const exists = localData.find((u) => u.email === email);\n        if (exists) {\n          return { error: { status: 409, data: '该邮箱已存在' } };\n        }\n        const user: SystemUser = {\n          id: `u-${String(nextId++).padStart(3, '0')}`,\n          name,\n          email,\n          role,\n          status: 'active',\n          lastLoginAt: null,\n          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        };\n        localData.unshift(user);\n        return { data: user };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['SystemUser'],\n    }),\n\n    updateUserRole: builder.mutation<void, { id: string; role: UserRole }>({\n      queryFn: ({ id, role }) => {\n        const user = localData.find((u) => u.id === id);\n        if (!user) return { error: { status: 404, data: '用户不存在' } };\n        user.role = role;\n        return { data: undefined };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['SystemUser'],\n    }),\n\n    toggleUserStatus: builder.mutation<void, string>({\n      queryFn: (id) => {\n        const user = localData.find((u) => u.id === id);\n        if (!user) return { error: { status: 404, data: '用户不存在' } };\n        user.status = user.status === 'active' ? 'disabled' : 'active';\n        return { data: undefined };\n      },\n      invalidatesTags: ['SystemUser'],\n    }),\n  }),\n});\n\nexport const {\n  useListUsersQuery,\n  useInviteUserMutation,\n  useUpdateUserRoleMutation,\n  useToggleUserStatusMutation,\n} = settingsApi;\n"
}

}
